dialogue.changed_synergy.pat_part.head.1: Just a few more scritches up there... please?
Oh, right there! That feels good, thank you!
That feels so comfortable, please don't stop.
dialogue.changed_synergy.pat_part.arm.0: H-Hey! I'm a bit ticklish there!
dialogue.changed_synergy.pat_part.arm.1: My arm? A bit of an odd place to greet me, but sure! Just be gentle, please.

When enabled, pursuit squads spawn only in the Overworld. By default, they can spawn in any dimension.
config.changed_synergy.option.independen: When enabled, gaining reputation with one faction never reduces a rival's reputation, so you can ally with every faction. Existing reputation losses are not restored.

menu.changed_synergy.social.social_inven: Close friends can share their inventory without forming an exclusive bond
message.changed_synergy.inventory.busy: Someone else is using this creature's inventory. Please wait.
message.changed_synergy.pursuit.warning: Your standing with %s has hit rock bottom. A pursuit squad is approaching. Find safety!
dialogue.changed_synergy.context.boundar: Hello! I just wanted to greet you human. I'll give you some room now.
Oh, okay. I'll give you some space now.
I'm already backing away, stop hitting me!
Are you challenging me? Challenge accepted!
That hurt! If you want to fight, then I'll fight back!
I already gave you space. If you keep attacking me, I'll strike back!
A weapon? I'm not standing here.
dialogue.changed_synergy.context.pursuit: That's the one who's been hurting us! Don't let them get away with it!
That's the one! You have done enough damage to us. We'll take you in!
There you are! Our community has sent us to stop you once and for all.
We found you! You won't swim away with it!
That's it! We've got you now. Everyone, stand down. Now!
Let's fall back! Stay together and head home. This isn't over!

config.changed_synergy.title: Changed: Synergy Settings
config.changed_synergy.performance.ai_su: Latex AI: %1$s ms/t (%2$s%% of server tick)
config.changed_synergy.performance.work_: Active latex: %1$s | Optional work: %2$s run / %3$s deferred
config.changed_synergy.option.performanc: Measures the complete AI time of loaded Changed creatures and sends one small status sample per second. Disable only when measuring the monitor itself.
config.changed_synergy.option.stagger_ba: Spreads optional creature scans across different ticks to remove population-wide lag spikes. Recommended on.
config.changed_synergy.option.background: Ticks between expensive idle decisions. Higher values improve server smoothness but make ambient reactions slower.
config.changed_synergy.option.distant_ai: Runs optional AI less often when no player is nearby. Combat targets and bonded companions remain responsive.
Within this distance of any player, optional AI runs at its normal configured interval. Smaller ranges reduce CPU use.
Multiplies optional AI intervals outside the active range. Higher values save more CPU in loaded background areas.
config.changed_synergy.option.adaptive_a: Defers non-critical background decisions after latex AI exceeds the soft tick budget. Deferred entities rotate fairly; combat and companion safety are never deferred.
config.changed_synergy.option.latex_ai_b: Soft milliseconds per server tick for all loaded Changed-creature AI. Lower values protect tick rate more aggressively; this cannot limit Changed's mandatory base AI.
config.changed_synergy.option.community_: Controls autonomous community roles, routine destination searches, and comfort activities. Disable to isolate settlement simulation during lag diagnosis.
config.changed_synergy.option.companion_: Controls native Changed, Addon and Synergy companion fishing, mining and cave lighting. Requires the Bond System and Creature Life world rules. Following, combat, rescue and camp production have separate controls.
config.changed_synergy.option.ambient_so: Controls unfamiliar-human approaches, ambient encounters, and non-bonded friend defence scans. Direct interaction, bonds, and companion safety remain active.
config.changed_synergy.option.enhanced_h: Controls Synergy sight memory, searching, noise alerts, underwater pursuit, and firearm evasion. Changed's native target AI remains available.
config.changed_synergy.defaults_applied: This page has been reset to its defaults.
config.changed_synergy.invalid_value: One or more values are invalid or outside their allowed range.
config.changed_synergy.server_note: Gameplay settings belong to the server; visuals belong to this client.
config.changed_synergy.remote_line_2: Admins can manage them with /changedsynergy config.
config.changed_synergy.option.respect_pa: Unarmed latex creatures with Changed Addon Plus's Pacified effect will not chase or attack players.
config.changed_synergy.option.pacify_pet: Continuously refresh Pacified on native Changed pets so they do not lock onto targets by mistake. Requires Changed Addon Plus.
config.changed_synergy.option.disable_pu: Removes the reduced-vision veil and Synergy's pure-white consensus screen effect. Target outlines and gameplay mechanics remain available.
config.changed_synergy.option.pet_regene: Regeneration level for native Changed pets. Zero disables it.
config.changed_synergy.option.awareness_: Maximum distance used when evaluating nearby players and creature relationships.
config.changed_synergy.option.ordinary_t: Allow Synergy transfur reversal through negotiation, bonded companions, and sleep. Takeover separation and the /untf and /untransfur recovery commands remain available when disabled.
config.changed_synergy.option.post_trans: Seconds before latex factions may become hostile again after a transfur or takeover release. Set to 0 to disable it.
config.changed_synergy.option.pat_pacifi: Allow a player's pat to stop a latex creature's pursuit and create a short ceasefire. Ordinary pat reactions and relationship progress still work when disabled.
config.changed_synergy.option.player_wil: Minimum horizontal distance from a player camp marker to a new wild outpost cache. Existing outposts stay in place. Default: 48 blocks.
config.changed_synergy.option.creature_o: Allow wild creatures to build or claim new outposts, including ruins, hives and aquatic caches. Off preserves existing outposts, storage and deliveries. Player camps and existing facility storage are unaffected.
config.changed_synergy.option.outpost_sp: Minimum horizontal distance in blocks between independently claimed wild outposts. Compatible nearby creatures still share an existing outpost.
config.changed_synergy.option.player_out: Player Outposts [Low impact]

Allow players to establish camps around campfires and manage trusted creatures. Requires the Creature Life world rule. Disabling it pauses camps and preserves their membership. Existing bell camps remain valid.
Player Outpost Resident Limit
Maximum camp members: 16 by default, configurable from 1 to 64. Existing saved limits and members are preserved.
Active Crew Limit
Maximum members following the owner at once: 6 by default, configurable from 1 to 32.
Player Outpost Supply Work [Low impact]
Let suppliers perform assigned work and deliver real resources to linked storage. Haulers collect leftover drops; other workers return their own produce before working again.
Outpost PvP Defense [Low impact]
Let guards defend the owner against an attacking player within the outpost. Disabled by default.
config.changed_synergy.option.changed_st: Provisioners without an outpost can claim generated Changed ruins and place a compact community store in empty space. The facility is always excluded.
config.changed_synergy.option.latex_bee_: Latex-bee provisioners can establish a small community store beside a generated Changed beehive.
config.changed_synergy.option.structure_: Loaded-chunk search radius for unclaimed Changed ruins and beehives. Larger values increase the occasional search cost.
config.changed_synergy.option.polite_int: Polite individuals may greet unfamiliar humans before deciding whether to hunt.
config.changed_synergy.option.polite_ran: Maximum distance at which a polite individual begins a cautious greeting.
config.changed_synergy.option.polite_spe: Navigation speed used while approaching a human politely.
config.changed_synergy.option.polite_wai: Seconds a polite individual waits for the human to respond with a pat.
config.changed_synergy.option.polite_att: Unanswered greetings before the individual returns to its usual attitude.
config.changed_synergy.option.visual_ran: Base distance for first noticing a player. Line of sight and field of view still apply.
config.changed_synergy.option.pursuit_ra: Base distance at which a creature keeps pursuing a confirmed target.
config.changed_synergy.option.lose_sight: Seconds without line of sight before a pursuer searches the last sighting.
config.changed_synergy.option.search_tim: Seconds spent investigating the last seen or heard player position.
config.changed_synergy.option.alert_radi: Distance over which compatible nearby creatures share a confirmed sighting.
config.changed_synergy.option.search_spe: Navigation speed used only while investigating or searching.
config.changed_synergy.option.gunshot_ra: Used by firearm integrations without their own sound range. TACZ supplies its own value.
config.changed_synergy.option.firearm_ev: Hostile creatures may move laterally while pursuing an armed player.
config.changed_synergy.option.grab_chanc: Chance that an eligible hostile grab starts its escape QTE.
config.changed_synergy.option.organic_gr: Separate grab chance for organic creatures, whose assimilation relies on physical grabs.
config.changed_synergy.option.mindless_m: Let latex creatures fully transfur mindless mobs such as zombies and skeletons. Disabled by default so they are absorbed instead, reducing the number of persistent entities created. Dedicated conversion forms from supported addons are preserved.
config.changed_synergy.option.disabled_o: Exclude starting forms by their full transfur form ID, separated by commas (e.g. changed:form_dark_latex_wolf/male). Leave empty for no additional exclusions. Applies to original and modded forms; existing origins are retained. On servers, edit BEHAVIOUR.DisabledOriginForms in changed_synergy-common.toml or use the server config command.
config.changed_synergy.option.modded_ori: Add playable transfur species from other installed mods to starting origin selection. Disabled by default. Bosses and excluded, partial, custom, benign or special-character forms remain unavailable. The starting origin gamerule still controls whether selection is enabled.
config.changed_synergy.option.secondary_: Allow hostile creatures to grab and transfur players who are already transfurred. When disabled, they attack instead. Native-origin players are always exempt from secondary transfur.
config.changed_synergy.option.creature_t: Choose native behavior, a per-encounter random method, assimilation, absorption, or takeover for hostile creature attacks and grabs. Takeover uses normal faction-standing outcomes and requires takeover to be enabled. Unsupported, organic, protected, and fusion encounters keep their native behavior.
config.changed_synergy.option.dialogue_r: Maximum distance at which a player can receive creature dialogue.
config.changed_synergy.option.dialogue_c: Minimum seconds between messages from the same speaker to the same listener.
Chance that an eligible state change produces a line.
config.changed_synergy.option.personalit: Chance that a suitable cue uses the individual's dominant-trait line.
config.changed_synergy.option.addon_anim: Let compatible creatures use Changed Addon's animal calls for some mood-dependent reactions.
config.changed_synergy.option.translator: An enabled Changed Addon Plus Translator interprets creature speech, even when telepathy is disabled. Turning this off disables the item bypass; it does not grant everyone telepathy.
config.changed_synergy.option.telepathy_: Completed standard transfurs needed for permanent telepathy. Set to 0 to prevent new unlocks while retaining existing understanding. Use Enable Telepathy to disable all telepathic understanding, including already unlocked players.
config.changed_synergy.option.legacy_scr: Optional: show the theme-coloured transfur mask that grows inward with progress. Leave this off to keep Changed's current display.
config.changed_synergy.option.legacy_ski: Optional: show staged latex coating on partially transfurred skins and first-person arms. Leave this off to keep Changed's current display.
config.changed_synergy.option.legacy_opa: Maximum opacity of the transfur progress screen effect.
config.changed_synergy.option.suit_vigne: Show a soft theme-coloured edge effect while wrapped by a pet or bonded creature.
config.changed_synergy.option.suit_opaci: Opacity of the friendly wrapping edge effect.
config.changed_synergy.option.danmaku.de: Show ordinary creature dialogue in the screen overlay. Disable it to use chat instead.
config.changed_synergy.option.dialogue_d: Choose random popups or horizontal danmaku. Auto uses popups for English and danmaku for CJK languages.
config.changed_synergy.option.territory_: Show biome entry subtitles and persistent information for facility areas.
config.changed_synergy.option.mechanic_h: Show one-time hints for Synergy's important interactions.
config.changed_synergy.option.negotiatio: Show a suggested next argument during negotiation. Suggestions can be wrong; offering food makes them much more reliable.
config.changed_synergy.option.qte_animat: Enable animated grab QTE and hypnosis-struggle presentation.
config.changed_synergy.option.reduced_mo: Keep fades and input feedback while removing shake, drift, and large scaling motion.

advancement.changed_synergy.first_contac: Get acquainted with a latex creature.
advancement.changed_synergy.trusted_frie: Build enough familiarity to call a creature your friend.
advancement.changed_synergy.close_compan: Become close friends with a latex creature.
advancement.changed_synergy.shared_momen: Spend some time playing with a creature you know.
advancement.changed_synergy.peace_offeri: Stop a pursuit with a well-timed pat.
advancement.changed_synergy.bonded_compa: Form your first exclusive bond with a latex creature.

advancement.changed_synergy.white_hive_c: As original white latex, be defended by the nearby white consensus.

advancement.changed_synergy.dark_faction: Earn the dark latex group's respect. Its latex crystals, wolf crystals, and dark puddles can no longer inflict transfur damage on you.
