message.changed_synergy.telepathy.unlock: The distant voices settle into words. You can now understand the telepathic network.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.bond_tran: We won't lose you to that change. I will cover you first.
Your body... We sense danger in it. I'll clean it.
Ah, the threat is no more. Good, you can come out now.
We caught it in time. Make sure to call sooner next time.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.bond_trans: Human! Stay with me, don't let it take over!
Human, your scent! It's almost gone! Don't let it get you!
That was too close. You are still yourself this time.
It finally backed off. Don't wander too far from me. Find your pace first.
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.bond_tr: The change is rising too fast. Follow my voice and come close.
Do not let it pull you under. I can shelter you until it recedes.
It is receding now. Take your time before you move away.
The pressure has eased. You are yourself again.
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.bond_tran: Hey! Don't let that change take over! Let me help you.
Oof... That was a close one. You were almost gone.
And there you are. I knew you were underneath that latex.
It finally backed off. Good news, but please be more careful next time, yes?
overlay.changed_synergy.hypnosis.title: Resist the gaze
overlay.changed_synergy.hypnosis.press: Pull your eyes away to break free
overlay.changed_synergy.hypnosis.capture: Its eyes are drawing you back...
dialogue.changed_synergy.hypnosis.hypno_: Look into my eyes. Take deep, slow breaths. Yes... just like that...
No need to hurry. Stay with me and everything will be over soon...
Oh, you woke up already? All right, take your time.
So you slipped out this time. I'll get you next time!
I learned your rhythm. No need to worry; I'll be gentle.
Tired already? Just stay still and let me come closer.
Hey! Who interrupted me?
Wait, you are awake? Who woke you up?!
Hey, no touching! You interrupted my rhythm!
Hey, you were supposed to look into my eyes! Why the pat?
So you came just to pat me? I like that plan a lot!
This is nicer than making you stare at me. Please, one more.
Don't rush, take your time. Enjoy your new paws and bright eyes.
Welcome to the pack! Use your new ears and listen to our surroundings.
Wanna try your focus? Okay, look into my eyes.
Oh, a staring contest? Alright, don't drift off on me, okay?
Hey, you actually held on! You are much sharper than you look.
Well, look at that. You successfully defeated me, fair and square.
Got you! Don't worry, it's just a game.
There goes your mind. That counts as my win.
dialogue.changed_synergy.hypnosis.lumina: Watch the light in my eyes. Try to break up the trance.
Ready? Hold my gaze and try to break the hypnosis.
Very well done! You were able to keep your thoughts intact.
Woah! You broke the pattern kinda quick. Not bad!
Take it easy. I got you now, no need to worry.
You saw that small pause? That gave you away.
dialogue.changed_synergy.hypnosis.kayla_: Follow the sway. Can you keep your focus from my eyes?
Eyes on me. Do not dare to drift with the current!
You did stay with the flow. Not bad at all!
So you were able to keep the focus. That's a point for you!
Are you still with us? Seems your mind went drifting into the current.
And there goes your drifting mind. This round is mine!
dialogue.changed_synergy.hypnosis.experi: Keep your focus on me. Let's see how sharp your mind is.
Keep your attention on my eyes. No tricks, just focus.
Well, you resisted that all right. I'll remember that.
So, you kept control. Good. Don't forget that feeling.
You lost your focus. This concludes the test.
Got your rhythm! No worries, that was just a practice.
Look at me. I want to try something with your focus...
Hold steady your focus and follow the pattern. Are you ready?
You totally got out from there, even faster than expected...
Wow! You broke MY focus. That's a point for you.
Got you! There goes your mind.
Hey, are you still with me here? Seems your mind went flying.
dialogue.changed_synergy.hypnosis.generi: Keep your eyes in here. I will put your focus to test.
Ready? Try to follow the rhythm and resist the hypnosis.
Hey, you actually broke free? Well played!
Oof, you are sharper than you look. You get a point there.
Caught your mind! Don't worry, I was just playing with you.
Your focus is gone. I score this round!
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.gunshot_h: Loud! That iron lump bites from afar! Everyone, back off!
My head... That noise! Spread out, don't let it roar again!
We won't tolerate that noise again. Stop Them now!
Aghhh... We hate that noisy iron thing! We will stop you now!
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.gunshot_f: Human... Please alert us if you're going to fire that thing again... We hate the noise.
My head... hums so much... Warn next time, please.
You are not the one roaring, but that thing?
No harm done to us... But the noise, was horrible!
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.gunshot_ho: Gah! Hot! That little thing is hot!
My head... Is still ringing! Don't let that human use it again!
I recognize that thing. I will not let it use it again.
AHH! What an awful roar! Stop it, before it does that again!
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.gunshot_fr: Ooff... My ears... are ringing... Warn me next time you use it.
HEY! HUMAN! I THINK THAT THING LEFT ME DEAF!
Wow! That thing sure is loud. I'm sure everyone in the pack heard it.
Did that little iron thing do ALL of that?!
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.gunshot: Gah, my ears! What made that noise?!
Ahhh!!! How does that thing roar so loud?!
That... Sound... Is horrible!!! Never do that again!
Ugh... Metal roars... I dislike such a sound so much...
AH!!!! Hey! Don't scare me like that!
I can smell the metal and burning of that roar... It is so penetrating...
Ohhh... My head is banging so hard... Why is that thing so noisy?
Hey, I know you have no ill intention, but can you at least warn me before you use it?
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.gunshot: That noise shook the water! Make the iron thing stop!
Even the surface jumped. Do not let them set it off again!
Again! The echo is everywhere underwater. Catch them first!
That iron lump scared every fish away. Do not let it roar again.
Ah! That sounds terrifying... What is that thing?
My head is still humming. Try it farther from the water next time, please?
I know you did not point it at me, but the water carried every bit of it.
Lower that noisy iron thing. We hear it far too clearly down here.
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.gunshot_h: Was that a roar?! Take that human down, quick!
Ugh! That noise... was horrible! Shut down that iron thing, don't let it shout again!
That terrible noise again! Pin it down!
Why is that iron bar so noisy? Take it away, now!
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.gunshot_f: WOAH!!! You scared me to death! Why is that thing so loud?
Ugh... I'm not used to that noise. Warn me before you use that thing again.
So is that iron thing the one roaring... I thought it was you for a moment.
That thing gives me the chills everytime you make it roar.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.firearm_n: A tool we've never seen before. What's its purpose?
What are you holding in your hands? I need to see it up close.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.firearm_no: Oh, a new tool? What does it do?
That's something I've never seen before. Can I check it?
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.firearm: Hmmm... That thing in your hand, smells weird. What does it do?
That thing is not alive, yet you hold it so firmly... Is it dangerous?
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.firearm: Does that metal thing mind water? I want to touch it.
What are you holding? It does not look like it can swim.
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.firearm_n: Oh? Is that one of those wacky tools you normally use?
That's one tool I've never seen before. Wonder what it does...
gamerule.changedSynergyNpcAI.description: Enable Synergy hostility pathfinding, sight memory, investigation and pursuit. Also requires Enhanced Hunt AI in server settings. Creature Life, camp work and relationship safety have separate controls.
gamerule.changedSynergyNpcDialogue.descr: Allows creatures to send nearby players contextual lines during social interactions and AI state changes.
gamerule.changedSynergyNpcEmotes.descrip: Allows creatures to display the same emotion bubbles used by the /emote command.
gamerule.changedSynergyFactionReputation: Enables faction standing gains, losses and their gameplay benefits.
gamerule.changedSynergyInitialFactionRep: Sets the reputation from -100 to 100 assigned when a player first encounters an uninitialized faction account. Existing reputation is not overwritten.
gamerule.changedSynergyBondSystem.descri: Enable bond creation, companion following, rescue, wrapping and companion controls. Disabling pauses bonded camp members and keeps existing bonds and assignments.
Enable familiarity, friendship, friend following and assistance. Disabling pauses friend camp members and keeps their memories and assignments.
Shows territory and facility context on the HUD. World generation and biome spawning are not changed.
gamerule.changedSynergyPersonalitySystem: Lets stable individual traits affect AI, tolerance, social habits and dialogue selection.
gamerule.changedSynergyCreatureLife.desc: Enable creature routines, wild communities, gathering, player camps and Pure White reformation. Turning it off pauses these activities and keeps saved camp membership. Individual AI and work switches still apply; placing or harvesting blocks respects mobGriefing.
gamerule.changedSynergyHypnosisQte.descr: Enables Synergy's gaze-resistance sequence, control lock and mesmerized penalty. Changed's base hypnosis remains when disabled.
gamerule.changedSynergyGrabQteEnhancemen: Enables server-synced grab prompts and the safety stun after escape. Changed's base grab remains when disabled, and creatures can attack again immediately after an escape.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.spotted_h: I can feel it... There's a human close! Do not run, we need to talk to you!
Human, don't run. We just want to know more about you.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.spotted_t: A visitor? We meant no harm to you, as long as you meant no harm to us.
New face. I see. Don't worry, we won't attack you.
We sense a shape we don't recognize. Are you friendly?
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.alert_hum: A human! Don't chase it away yet. Let's see what it does.
We see you... Still, we don't know what you're doing.
We have waited so long to see a human. Please, stay around.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.alert_tra: We don't recognize you. Stay where you are.
They went that way. They think we haven't picked up their scent...
Observe first. We don't know their intentions yet.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.heard_hum: We see, human steps? Real human steps?
Silence. A human is close. We can hear it...
That scent... That's a human's scent... One that is still alive.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.heard_tra: We hear you... We don't know who you are though.
Don't move. They're making noise over there.
Unfamiliar sound. Are they there to help us?
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.lost_huma: The human... Is no more? No... We still feel it close.
We know you are still close. We will find you.
Hiding won't help you, human. We won't give up.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.lost_tran: Their trail, is lost. Let's stop and listen. It may still be close.
We lost sight of the transfurred one. Don't worry, we'll catch up.
Hiding? Nice try. We can still feel your presence.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.reacquire: We see you now! Don't run anymore, we will find you anyway.
Ah, there you were. We need to talk about you escaping now.
Ah, human. Everyone is looking for you. Come closer...
Your form is too notorious for us. You can't escape from us that easily.
There you are again. Don't run, there's no point in it.
You're here. We would like to hear why you're escaping so eagerly.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.give_up_h: The scent... is gone... Human, we will know if you are around again, don't forget it.
Let it go. We will get our opportunity another time.
Where did the human go? We saw its trail not long ago!
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.give_up_t: No reason to keep chasing it. Let it go.
Leave it. We know its scent. We will know if it gets any closer.
They're gone. Stop chasing, we'll have our chance another time.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.spotted_hu: Hold on. That's a human, a real one. Pass the word to the others!
A real human? Wow, it's been so long. Let me talk with him, don't rush yet.
Human in sight! Nobody move! I'll make first contact.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.spotted_tr: Welcome, stranger. We have a simple rule: don't start anything, and neither will we.
We see you. If you're friendly, so we will be.
Hey, new face. This is our territory. Don't cause trouble and we won't either.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.alert_huma: Human spotted! Flank him, don't let him take initiative.
Catch that human! But do not harm him. The Alpha wants it alive.
Stay alert for sudden movements. I'll get on him first!
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.alert_tran: I do not recognize that scent... Find it! Let's see who that really is.
Identify that one. We won't leave that scent until we know its source.
Search the perimeter. Don't let him split us.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.heard_huma: These footsteps... Human? Pass the word back. The pack must know!
Shhh! I heard a human. Let's try to flank it. The rest, wait for the signal.
That scent... it is unmistakenly human's! Do not let him slip away.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.heard_tran: Those steps... I do not recognize them...
I heard that! Stay alert, we're not alone.
Human? No... Whose steps are those?
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.lost_human: I've lost its scent. Find its trace! Chances like this are rare.
Grrr... It got away. Keep searching, it may be hiding somewhere.
Wait, where is it? Cut off all escape routes! He will not escape that easily.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.lost_trans: Huh? It was here a moment ago! Keep searching! It may be still close.
Hiding, eh? Everyone, search around. It won't be escaping us.
Trail ends here. Huh, clever guy...
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.reacquired: There it is. Everyone, pull back! Don't drive it off again.
So there you were. You really threw off the whole pack.
Found you. Don't worry, this is between you and me.
Target on sight. Close all escape routes.
There you are. You're good, but I'm better!
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.give_up_hu: Grrr... The scent's totally gone. Everyone, let's go back home.
The human's gone. Let's tell the Alpha about this human.
Ok, human! You were lucky this time, but you won't next time!
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.give_up_tr: Stop the chase. Let it go. It is not a threat to us.
Everyone, fall back. Let's regroup and prepare a strategy to capture this prey.
He's gone. Don't chase it beyond our territory.
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.spotted: That scent... I cannot mistake it... It is a human!
I feel it; heartbeat, breath, body heat... That's a human without a doubt!
Hey, human! Don't run, please. I just haven't seen one of yours in so long.
I can feel your scent. I'm not used to it, but we can get along if you mean no harm.
Hey, outsider. State your intentions and I won't trouble you.
I do not recognize your scent. Please, come closer. I want to know more about you.
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.alert_h: That human, is on the loose! Don't let it get away!
Surround that human. I need answers; why did he attack us?
Hey! Don't you dare run freely around here without us noticing.
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.alert_t: You're fast, I give you that. But are you smarter?
Flank it. Don't leave any room for escaping.
Follow its smell. It won't get away that easily.
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.heard_h: That's a faint scent, but it is unmistakable; a real human is close...
Everyone, stop! I've heard something... I haven't heard in so long...
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.heard_t: Huh, someone's trying to sneak around. I can hear it.
Hm? I smell someone's nearby... I wonder who it might be.
That's a scent I do not recognize. Let's follow the lead...
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.lost_hu: Wait, where's the scent? I know it was here a moment ago!
Shhh! Everybody stay on guard. It may still be close.
Is it... Holding its breath? I can't hear it anymore...
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.lost_tr: Wait, is it running in circles? No... Agh! I've lost it!
I can't feel the scent anymore. Dang it...
The tracks end here. It may still be close, so I'll not lower my guard.
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.reacqui: Aha! I got the scent again! You won't get away this time!
Oho! I can hear your racing heart! Are you scared or excited for this chase?
There you are! I'm not giving up this opportunity.
I knew you were here. Your scent gave you away.
Found you! Don't make this harder for you, I can do this chase all day.
You think that form of yours gives you an advantage? Think twice!
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.give_up: The scent is fading... Ugh, I really wanted to see that human up close...
Oooff.. Ooofff... How is that human so agile?
Pah! Not worth the effort. I'll be ready for it the next time it comes.
It has gone too far already. No worth in chasing it that far away.
Y'know, screw you. I see no worth in chasing you.
You may be gone now, but I'll remember that scent of yours.
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.spotted: Wait, up on shore... is that a human? Really?
A human! Slow down, please! Don't leave yet!
A real person on the shore! Stop splashing, I want to see!
Someone new by the water... Can you swim? Keep it friendly and we can play.
I haven't seen anyone move like that. No problem, just don't cause trouble by the water.
I see you. Relax. Keep things friendly and so will we.
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.alert_h: Hold the shallows. Don't scare them into deep water.
Move around both sides. Humans don't come often; don't make a mess of this.
They're heading ashore. Meet them ahead, gently!
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.alert_t: They know how to use the water. Spread out and don't collide.
Hold the channel. I'll circle underneath.
They're heading for dry ground. Leave one by the water.
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.heard_h: That water sounds wrong... human footsteps.
A real human was by the shore. The ripples are fresh.
Quiet. I hear footsteps I haven't heard in years.
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.heard_t: Light water movement. That's someone transfurred.
That splash wasn't made by one of ours.
The current was disturbed. They're nearby.
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.lost_hu: The water's still... but I know I saw a human.
The tracks stop here. Search the bank slowly; don't drive them away.
Lost them. Everyone wait. They may come back to the water.
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.lost_tr: The ripples stop here. They know how to hide.
Lost them. Don't chase blindly through cloudy water.
No tracks on shore. Get back in and listen.
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.reacqui: There you are! Slow down, I wasn't finished looking at you!
There you are! You have no idea how busy the water got.
Found you! I don't mean to scare you, I just didn't want to lose you again!
Found you. Water gives away your movement.
There you are again. You know how to use the water too.
Over there. Don't churn up this water.
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.give_up: They're too far... back to the water. We have news to tell.
Stop chasing. At least a human really came to the water today.
Let them go. Next time, nobody splashes them the moment we meet.
They've left the water. Don't follow.
Head back. A stranger isn't worth leaving the water for.
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.spotted_h: Wait, is that... AN ACTUAL HUMAN!
That scent... I know that scent very well! Don't run off, human!
Hey, human! Get over here! He's mine! Back off!
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.spotted_t: Oh, a visitor. I'm a bit bored, wanna play something?
Well, that's a new face around. Do not cause any trouble and we'll be fine.
Mmmm that's a new scent... New face, perhaps?
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.alert_hum: He's on the move! Quick, suround him, don't let him get away!
The human went that way. Keep the trail hot, don't let it slip away!
I'm going ahead. If anyone scare him off, they'll answer to me!
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.alert_tra: They are real quick, huh? No matter. Stay on its tail!
Circle both sides! Leave no opening for a counterattack!
I'll push him forward. Catch it on the path ahead.
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.heard_hum: Stop! Are those human footsteps? And not a transfurred one?
That smell... That's a human, one that hasn't passed away in years...
I sense a human nearby. Approach slowly, we don't want him running away.
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.heard_tra: I don't recognize these footsteps... An outsider perhaps?
I may not be able to see you, but I know you're close...
I cannot recognize that smell. Check carefully, and don't let it get away.
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.lost_huma: Wait, where's that scent? That was a real human scent moments ago.
Don't run in circles! Smell the air and keep the chase. This is a golden opportunity!
It managed to hide from me. Clever human, but I'm still on the chase!
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.lost_tran: The scent stops here. Where is it hiding?
I can't see it, but doesn't mean it is completely lost. Stop and listen carefully. It could still be close.
It managed to shake me. This one's pretty sneaky, eh?
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.reacquire: AHA! There you are! You won't get away this time!
There you were hiding! You had everyone searching in circles.
Hello again, human! Can I finally get a quick look at you? Just a peek.
Hoho! Got your pace! You'll not miss me this time.
Well you used one clever trick to hide. It won't work twice!
I can see you again! Let's resume this chase!
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.give_up_h: I almost lost that scent... Aw, that was a real human, was it?
Oof... Too tired... Next time... I will try to speak with it first...
I'll give you this round. Let's go home. Let's tell everybody we actually saw a human.
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.give_up_t: Oof... Okay, okay... You win... Let's race again some other day.
Nah, that's no fun chasing you outside our grounds. Get over here!
Whoever that is, we got his scent remembered. We'll recognize it right away if it returns.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.success_a: You are one of us now. Feel the noise yourself...
Welcome your new body. Don't push too hard, we will help you.
The latex is covering you now. Welcome to us.
Hold. We will travel as one from now on.
The chase is over. We will be as one.
No need to fight anymore. Feel the noise for yourself.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.meet_ally: One of us is here. Come, stay with us for a while.
Ah, good timing. Watch the other side, my ally.
You, no need to stand so far. Get close to us.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.meet_riva: Hsss! You... Your stench is not welcome.
You, creature. Stay away from us.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.meet_outs: We sense something new. Is the new thing hostile or friendly?
You're not one of us. Still, it seems you mean no harm.
A first meeting with a stranger. Let's relax together, we want to know who you are.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.ally_fall: Our ally has fallen! Check on them, quick!
Help our friend, it needs backup!
You have hurt us. You will pay for your actions now!
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.success_as: Welcome to our pack! Let the others greet you and know you.
You fought well, but from now on, you are one of us. Welcome.
Ah, that sharp in your eyes. I expect a lot from you, 'buddy.'
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.success_ab: You're mine. We'll be together from now on.
Shh... Let me complete the absorption. I'll let you steer the body if you behave.
Chase's over, I won. Don't worry, I'll put your strength for good use.
Ah, an ally. Help me with my chores, would you?
Hey, there! Mind keeping an eye around? I'll be back shortly.
One of our kind. Come, give me a hand over here.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.meet_rival: You! Don't take another step, or I'll retaliate!
Stop right there! You are NOT welcome here!
Ugh... I can smell your stench from miles away. What do you want?
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.meet_outsi: Well, hello, new face. This is our territory. If you don't cause any trouble, we won't have to chase you out.
Hey, stranger. You can come through. Just behave, ok?
A face I do not recognize. It's fine, as long as you don't swing first.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.ally_falle: One of us has fallen! Everyone, pin that murderer!
You will be avenged... Don't let the culprit get away with it!
Who did this? WHO?! SHOW YOURSELF!
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.success: This ends our chase. Take a few steps, let the change take over your body.
Don't force it. Let your new body get used to this.
Ah, it was a great chase. You can now keep up with us.
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.meet_al: I smell... A familiar scent. I wonder... Would you like to come with me?
Ah, an ally! Want to walk around with me? I would like to enjoy your company.
I see you there, buddy. Don't go too far; I want to keep track of you.
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.meet_ri: Grrrr... I sense hostility in your scent!
Keep your distance! You are not welcome here!
I'm watching you. Don't try anything strange, or I'll personally take you down.
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.meet_ou: Hmmm... I don't recognize that scent, yet I sense no hostility from it.
Hello, stranger. If you mean no harm, I won't trouble you.
I haven't met you before... Oh, no need to panic; I'm just learning your scent.
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.ally_fa: NO!!! ONE OF OURS IS DOWN! MOVE, NOW!
I can't hear its breathing anymore... The enemy will pay for this!
We will remember this for ever; we'll never be so careless again!
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.success: All done. Try the water, then try the land.
Welcome. Take your time. You'll get used to it soon.
It worked! Now you can keep up with us in the water.
Got you. Stay quiet in there and I'll take us swimming.
No more chase. We are joined now.
Do not panic. Follow my breathing for a moment.
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.meet_al: You too? Race me to the far side.
Good timing. Let's watch this stretch of water together.
A familiar face. Come stay for a while.
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.meet_ri: This water does not welcome you. Stop.
A hostile visitor. Keep them away.
Back off. Stir things up again and we fight.
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.meet_ou: Haven't seen you before. Swimmer or not, just keep it friendly.
There's room for a new face by the shore. Don't cause trouble and we'll get along.
A new visitor? Welcome. Just keep things friendly.
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.ally_fa: Do not leave them there alone.
Who hurt them? Watch the area.
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.success_a: Got you! And you get a brand new form as punishment. Hope you like it!
There you go, a brand new shape for you. No need to rush, get used to it first.
Welcome to the pack! You will get used to it quickly, so don't push over.
Haha! Got you! Let's go together from now on.
Shhh... Let's go together from now on. No more chasing, ok?
We will now become one. Don't worry, your conscience will still be intact.
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.meet_ally: I know you. Wanna race with me?
That's a face I recognize. Got anything fun to do?
I have spotted an ally. I was wondering where you were.
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.meet_riva: Back off. You are NOT welcome here!
Don't you dare to come any closer!
I recognize that nasty smell. If you start a fight, I'll take you down quickly!
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.meet_outs: Are you lost? Not a problem. Just be nice, and we'll be nice as well.
Passing through our turf, eh? You're brave, just don't make a mess.
I could swear I've seen your face somewhere. Are you a distant cousin?
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.ally_fall: Who did this?! I will take my revenge on the culprit!
Stop staring! Search for suspicious activity! This is not over!
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.bond_welc: Welcome to us, my bond. Now the others will help you as well.
I welcome you, my bond. The others will now recognize you anywhere.
We will now be as one, my bond. Welcome to us.
Yes, my bond. We will stay together from now on.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.pat_bonde: Ah, all of us felt that. It was a fantastic greeting.
We accept your patting gladly, my bond.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.pat_kin.0: Ah, a patting from one of us. I accept it happily.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.pat_kin.1: We know this patting anywhere. Thank you.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.pat_frien: Ah, is that a greeting? Understood, we now acknowledge it.
A friend of mine is a friend of us. Thank you for the greeting.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.pat_outsi: We don't know you, but we see you meant no harm. We will step back now.
Unfamiliar greeting, but we feel no harm in it. Good, we won't chase for now.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.pat_human: The human is bold enough to make first contact? We acknowledge that bravery.
The human hand... Is warmer than expected. We are starting to enjoy the human's patting.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.pat_rival: Remove your hands! We hate your stench.
Are you testing our patience? Don't make any sudden moves.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.pat_playe: It's my turn. Hold still and let me care for you now, my bond.
My bond, you have always patted me. Now is my turn to return the pats.
You're one of us. You deserve a proper greeting.
Stand closer. I want to see how you have been lately.
Do not be afraid. I just want to check who you are.
We see your kind know about greetings. Do you know about this one?
Hsss! You have betrayed our trust. Never again, we know that now!
You appealed to our trust, then struck as soon as we gave it. We will remember what you did.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.pat_truce: We trusted you once. We won't believe in your patting again.
Do not try that again. We all remember what followed.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.bond_welco: I welcome thee, to our brotherhood. You are one of us now.
Welcome to the pack. Stay with me, and I'll cover your back.
Chase's over. You and I will continue as one.
You will not be alone anymore. We'll continue this adventure together.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.pat_bonded: I've seen you too, human. Now, let's continue our duties.
Thank you, partner! Okay, let's take a small rest.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.pat_kin.1: Ah, an excellent greeting. I thank you.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.pat_friend: Oh, so you have learned this greeting too?
Nice greeting, friend. I need not to be on guard with you around.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.pat_outsid: Patting me without warning? I could rip your arm off. Don't be reckless.
Oh, was that a peace offering? Understood, we'll not attack you.
Eh? Why did you pat me when I was chasing you? I'm confused...
Huh? Where that patting came from?
Hands off! I know you and your people.
Don't try to act nice with me. I'm not falling for your trickery.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.pat_player: Human, it's your turn to get a pat.
You gave me a pat before, now's your turn to get patted.
Come here, my fellow companion. Come say hello properly.
Hello, comrade. Have you been working hard for our people?
Stay still one moment, I need to check you closely so I can recognize you later.
So, your people do not greet others like this? That's news for me.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.betrayed.0: You mischievous creature! You will pay for that trickery you pulled there!
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.betrayed.1: Hey, patting, then attacking? If you want a fight, come to me head on, coward.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.pat_truce_: Take back your hand. I know what you did last time. I'm not falling for it.
You tried that trick before; I'm not falling for it again.
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.bond_we: I can feel your scent already changing. Welcome to us, partner!
I see the change is a success. Can you smell my scent now?
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.pat_bon: Aha! That's a pat I recognize everywhere. What's up, partner?
Ah... Yes... Right there... Only you know this weakness for patting of mine...
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.pat_kin: Hello, my fellow friend. Tell me, what's on your mind?
I can recognize a fellow pack member's greeting anywhere. I won't mind getting another greeting.
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.pat_fri: Your scent... Is different... Yet very calming.
No need to worry; I won't chase a friend.
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.pat_out: I sense no hostility in this greeting. Good, we can get along just fine.
Hmmm... Your hand, is so warm... I see you meant no harm.
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.pat_hum: Huh... Well, eh... Ok, I admit; I didn't expect a human to pat me.
I never felt a human hand before. It feels so warm that I feel the urge to stop chasing you.
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.pat_riv: Tsk! Take away your hand! I know you and your kind very well!
I will ask you this once; move your hand, NOW!
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.pat_pla: Come here, bud. Let's check if you are not injured.
Hey, don't dodge. I just want to greet you like the first time we met.
A perfectly matching smell. I recognize a fellow clan member anywhere.
Come closer one moment. Your breathing... Hm... Yes, you're fine. No worries.
Hello, stranger. This is how we do greetings around.
Hmm... That body heat of yours, I'll remember it.
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.betraye: Your scent completely tricked me. I know your intentions now!
I knew your scent was hiding something sinister. Keep your hands away from me.
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.pat_tru: Did you really think I'd forget about what you did? I'll not forget that first hit of yours that easily.
Move your hand from me. Your treacheries won't work twice on me.
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.bond_we: I helped you become this. Swim with me from now on.
Welcome, partner. Water or land, I will stay nearby.
We really are inseparable now. I will remember you.
The chase is over. I carry both of us from here.
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.pat_bon: Yes, that pressure is just right. Again?
One touch from you, and even the water feels calmer.
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.pat_kin: Our kind knows how to say hello.
That feels good. Do the same next time.
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.pat_fri: A greeting from another water? Not bad.
All right, I accept. Rest with me.
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.pat_out: Making peace this way? Fine, I won't chase.
Steady hand. All right, you mean no harm.
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.pat_hum: A human came to the water on purpose? That's rare.
Trading that for a breather? Fine, take a moment.
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.pat_riv: Do not touch me. This is not a peace meeting.
Move your hand. I am still watching you.
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.pat_pla: You always greet me first. Come here, my turn.
Stand closer. I owe you one.
One of mine, do not dodge.
Come here. I want to see how you have been swimming.
You look unusual. May I touch?
Relax. A waterfolk greeting is gentle.
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.betraye: The water had barely settled when you struck. That was no peace offering.
I really did stop when you touched me. I will not make that mistake twice.
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.pat_tru: Do not touch me. Last time the water settled, you attacked.
Move your hand. I will not give you another chance to catch your breath.
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.bond_welc: Remember this change. Stay close from now on.
Welcome, partner. Let's share the road ahead.
No more chase. From now on, we watch the road together.
You'll be right here from now. I will never forget this bond.
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.pat_bonde: Ah... That's the right spot. You know me very well!
I can take those pats all day. Please don't stop.
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.pat_kin.0: I recognize that greeting. How's our friend going?
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.pat_kin.1: Ah... That's a nice greeting, I don't mind another patting.
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.pat_frien: That's one nice patting... Even for an outsider. I'll remember it.
Oh? Well, thank you! Perhaps we may be friends after all.
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.pat_outsi: Never seen that greet before. I suppose you're a friend...?
A brave move for an outsider. Alright, carry on. We're okay for now.
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.pat_human: So that's how humans make contact. Ok, I accept the pat!
Hmmm... I liked that greeting pat. That may be the start of our friendship.
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.pat_rival: Take your hands off me. We're not friends! Be grateful I'm not bashing you.
You won't distract me. Step back, now!
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.pat_playe: Come here, partner. You get some patting yourself as well.
Don't move. It's your turn to get a greeting.
Ah, that's a kin greeting. Get closer, friend.
I accept the greetings of members all day.
Let me do one gentle touch. You're a new face around.
You're not from around, yes? Come, let me give you a proper greeting.
Hey! That was uncalled for! We could have been friends.
First a pat, then a hit? Are you looking for a fight?
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.pat_truce: Do not try that on me. We both know what happened afterwards.
Keep you hands back. I fell for it once, never again.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.pat_playe: Come here. We just want to say hello.
Do not move away. We just want to greet you properly.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.attacked_: Our enemies have engaged in combat! We will retaliate back!
We see there's no more room for talking. We now take action!
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.pat_player: Hey, my friend. Come here and greet me properly.
No need to dodge my greeting. It's just how we friends salute each other.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.attacked_b: They finally decided to attack back. Everyone, engage!
I was expecting this from you. It's our turn to hit back!
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.pat_pla: Don't move one second; I think I saw a small twig on your shoulder.
Hey there, friend. No worries, this is just a gentle touch.
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.attacke: I knew it was a matter of time before you engage. I will not hold back on you!
You dare hit me? I will not let this go unpunished!
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.pat_pla: Friend, come say hello.
One touch. I will not pull you into the water.
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.attacke: The enemy moved first. Keep them off the water!
They muddied everything. Push them back.
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.pat_playe: You're a friend, no need no dodge a pat.
You get one pat from me, my friend. Don't let it go to waste.
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.attacked_: I was waiting for you to cross the line! Now you'll get what you're asking for!
Here they come! Don't let 'em get through!
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.meet_spec: One of us. It is a comforting sight.
We see you, my kind. Come closer so I can check you properly.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.meet_cate: Not the same, yet one of us. Such an oddity you are.
One of... us? You look oddly familiar, yet somewhat different.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.meet_frie: We see you mean no harm. No need to stay tense around.
We acknowledge your differences. We enjoy your peaceful company.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.former_bo: Are you a human again? Don't worry, we still recognize you.
You came back. Fear not, we won't change you again.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.former_re: A partner of yours stands beside you. We respect their choice.
Your partner trusts you, so no one will chase you.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.pat_categ: We feel some familiarity. Are you truly one of us?
We know that greeting from somewhere, yet we don't fully recognize you.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.pat_forme: Same familiar hand. Changing back has not altered that. That is good.
We know you. Your greeting feels warmer now.
The trust of your partner is valuable to us. We acknowledge this trust.
For your partner's sake, we can live in harmony.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.pat_playe: One of us, no matter where you are from. Come here.
Let us greet you. We want to know how much we share in common.
A human? No... My former bond! I am glad to see you in good shape.
We sense a familiar scent. My former bond, it is good to see you.
No need to be afraid. Your partner has already spoken for you.
We trust your partner, so we trust you. Let us know your scent.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.hit_confu: Hm? Why did you hit one of us? Was that an accident?
You attacked one of us. We demand an explanation.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.hit_warni: This is your second attack. Stop, or we will take action.
We are starting to feel hostility. Have you decided to battle us?
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.hostility: We now sense your true intentions. We won't back away anymore.
No more peace. We will stop you now!
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.secondary: You think your form protects you? We will force you into becoming one of us!
We got you! Don't worry, you will be one of us, either you like it or not.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.meet_speci: Ah, one of our kind. Stay with us, and you will be safe.
Oh, same species? You're more than welcome to stay around!
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.meet_categ: I see we share a lot of similarities, enough for me to call you my ally.
Ah, my distant kin is coming to visit I see.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.meet_frien: Haven't seen your face before, but you seem friendly. Want to stay around?
You don't look like you came looking for trouble... Fine, stay with us.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.former_bon: You got your human form back I see. No matter, you're still my partner.
I still recognize you, doesn't matter the form you take.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.former_res: A comrade of our ally is our comrade. Come over, let me greet you.
If your partner deems you friendly, then we deem you friendly as well.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.pat_catego: That's one different patting. A nice patting nonetheles.
Hmmm, so that's how our distant kin greet each other. I'll remember it.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.pat_former: Ah, a familiar greeting, just a little different.
Now that's a greeting I know. It's good to know that I can still count on you.
For your partner's sake, I accept that.
Very well. Today, we are acquaintances.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.pat_player: Come here. Our kin gets greeted, no matter if it is distant.
Do not be afraid. I only want to know you better.
My partner thinks he can fool me. Try better, buddy!
You finally got your form back. Do not wander far from the team, ok?
Your partner deems you trustworthy. We will respect that trust as well.
No need to be afraid. We respect the bond you have made with your partner.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.hit_confus: Hey! Why did you do that?
Stop! What are you trying to achieve?
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.hit_warnin: I said stop already! You will regret it if you continue!
I let it slide the first time, but again? What you're trying to achieve?
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.hostility_: So you decided to fight with me then. Prepare yourself!
Give me room. It wants a fight, and I'll give it what it wants.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.secondary_: You bring this to yourself. Now you will pay the price.
Got you! You will be one of us, either you like it or not!
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.meet_sp: Your scent... Your movement... Are so oddly familiar... Are you my same species?
No wonder why I felt a scent just like mine so close. I feel I'm looking myself into a mirror.
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.meet_ca: Your scent is strongly similar, yet not the same. Perhaps a distant kin?
Hey, close kin. I could hear your heartbeat a mile away.
You are similar to me. I can tell even from this far away.
Our bodies share a familiar rhythm. I can feel it from here.
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.meet_fr: Hmmm... Unfamiliar scent... But, no hostility detected. Yeah, we can stay close to each other.
I vaguely recognize you. Let's stick around for a while, so I won't forget about your scent.
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.former_: I recognize that scent of yours, buddy. I'm just shocked on how you can easily become human again.
Hey there, partner. Oh, don't worry; I won't change you back... Unless you want me to of course, hehe.
I feel a scent of a familiar being near you. A friend of a friend perhaps?
I see your partner standing with you, so you are not prey to me.
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.pat_cat: I feel you're very related to me in some way. Are you a distant relative?
Huh... For some reason, my body tells me I can trust you. I cannot deny you look a bit like me, however.
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.pat_for: I sense you have gone through some changes. Still, I recognize that pat of yours anywhere.
It's nice to have you back, bud, be as human form or not.
I sense no danger from you, especially since your partner is advocating for you.
Hm... Your breathing is a little fast. Are you nervous? No need to be.
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.pat_pla: Get closer. I want to greet you properly.
You look... familiar... Please, get a bit closer. I want to memorize your scent.
No matter how much you change forms, your scent gives you away.
Buddy, I just want to check you out. I have no intention of changing you.
No need to be afraid. I respect your partner, therefore I respect you as well.
If your partner accepts you, so will I. Let me get your scent first.
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.hit_con: Grrr... HEY! Why did you do that?
Ouch! Hey, you did that by mistake, yeah?
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.hit_war: Hey! I told you it hurts! Stop doing that!
Ow! I won't tolerate this; hit me again, and you'll pay the price!
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.hostili: Fine! You asked for it. En garde!
You were warned, and you continued attacking. Fine! I'll stop you myself!
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.seconda: Aha, got you! Let me do a small trick here... Don't be scared...
Hey, quit rambling. I'll make this quick for you.
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.meet_sp: Just like me. No wonder your movement looks familiar.
One of my kind! Want to take a lap together?
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.meet_ca: Different look, familiar habits in water.
Close kin. There is room here, come over.
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.meet_fr: You make good company by the water, whatever your kind.
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.former_: Human again, and you still came to me. I know you.
I will not drag you back into the old form.
Your partner is here. If they trust you, we stop.
Your partner stays with you. This water is safe.
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.pat_cat: A close cousin has an interesting technique.
Nice. Not quite the same as my own kind.
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.pat_for: A warmer hand now, but the movement is still yours.
I remember this greeting. Welcome back.
All right, your partner already spoke for you.
I accept. Just stay near them.
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.pat_pla: Come here, cousin.
Let me see whether you are this comfortable near water too.
Human again? Do not hide from me. Come say hello.
I know it is you. I just wanted to come close again.
Your partner is beside you. Relax.
I will be gentle. We respect their choice.
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.hit_con: Was that play, or did you miss?
Wait. Why did you attack me?
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.hit_war: That's twice now. Don't do that again.
One more, and I will stop calling this a joke.
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.hostili: Fine. You swam to the hostile side yourself.
They want a fight. Catch them before they get far.
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.seconda: Caught. Let this rough current end here.
The second assimilation is quick. Behave afterward.
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.meet_spec: I recognize that shape. No wonder why you look so good!
Ah, so you look like me? Wanna race me?
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.meet_cate: Hmm, you look familiar... A far away cousin perhaps?
Ah, a distant kin. We can share the ground all right.
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.meet_frie: Different kind, still good company. I'm don't mind having you around.
I see you're not hostile. That's nice. Let's travel for a while, yeah?
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.former_bo: Ah, that's my human partner there. Don't worry, I still recognize you.
I know that scent clearly. No matter the shape, you're still my partner.
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.former_re: I see your partner still stans beside you. As long as they're here, I won't bother you.
We will not bother you... As long as yout partner stays around.
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.pat_categ: That's a greeting I haven't seen in a while.
Hmmm, that's one unusual greeting. Still one greeting I like.
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.pat_forme: Ah, a human classic. That's something I enjoy, doesn't matter your shape.
I recognize that patting all right. Please continue, don't stop.
With you and your partner here, I can relax.
That's a familar greeting. I accept it.
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.pat_playe: Hey, distant kin. Don't act as a stranger, come say hello!
How's everything, buddy? Wonder what do we have in common.
Hey, human! You get a greeting from me. Don't you dare dodge it!
There, human. Hey, don't be afraid, I'm just greeting you, not changing you.
I can see your partner is with you. Don't worry, I will not engage.
I know your partner is watching. Can I still get a small greeting?
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.hit_confu: Hey! Why did you do that all of a sudden?
Ouch! That was uncalled for! Why did you do that?
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.hit_warni: That's your second strike. You do it again, you'll regret it...
Stop it! This is your last warning!
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.hostility: That's it! I've tried to be nice, but I see you wanted a fight. Alright, you got it!
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.secondary: I've got you! Don't struggle and accept this new form.
You bring this upon yourself. Now, stand firm and find back your footing.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.bond_wrap: You are so fragile. Come, let my body cover you.
No need to push yourself alone, my bond. Rest inside, and wait until it is safe.
I see you need my body. I accept your request. Let us move together.
We acknowledge we can continue steadier together, my bond. Let us become one for now.
You want to feel the noise? We are glad to hear you say that.
You want to see what it feels like? We are much obliged, my bond.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.bond_reve: My bond, please don't move. I'm extracting the latex out of your body.
Wait... this isn't just a coating anymore. If I pull it away, I might hurt you. Let's not risk it.
All of the latex is back. How is your body feeling, my bond?
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.bond_wrap: My bond, we will cover you for a moment. We won't change your actual form.
Come inside, my bond. I will let you go once everything is quiet.
My bond, you no longer look familiar. Still, we will take care of you.
Come, let us rest together, so I can acknowledge this new form.
My bond, I kept you warm all night with my body. Hope you had a good night's sleep.
My bond, did you notice you used my body as pajamas?
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.bond_reas: Very well, my bond. I'll give you our form back.
I welcome you back to us. This time, it is your choice.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.bond_rele: My bond, I feel no more danger around. We will still stay alert.
You can come out now, my bond. Walk carefully, don't trip over.
We sense no peril anymore. My bond, you can come out.
All is clear. You can now come out, but don't go too far.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.bond_emer: My bond! Come over, let me wrap you up!
We won't let you die, my bond. We will cover you up.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.bond_comb: My body... Feels heavy... My bond... Please, take me with you.
My bond, my body is heavily injured. Let me stick with you while I heal us both.
My bond, I'll hold this one. Finish it, now!
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.bond_emer: We see your health is back. Good. We'll let you out now.
We feel your steady breathing now. You had us way too worried!
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.bond_riva: We feel an already existing bond. We won't cut it.
We will change you, but not your bond. Your partner will still be waiting for you.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.bond_jeal: My bond, Have you accepted another's form? We demand an explanation.
Looking at you, and I'm not fully accepting this form, my bond.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.bond_new_: We saw your new form, but you still decided to stay with us. It is a relief for us.
You feel different, my bond. Still, we know it is still you.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.bond_deat: Uhhh... My bond... We, no, I can't feel you anymore...
My bond, please run! This place has become too dangerous! Don't... Forget... About... Us...
My bond... My body can't protect us any longer. Get out, run, and... Don't... Look...Back...
My body can no longer help us, my bond. Please, stay alive... For us...
We died as a truly bonded pair. We are happy... To end... Together...
My bond, don't be afraid. We will hold you together until... The very... End...
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.pat_bonde: We feel that familiar touch. My bond, we still know it is you.
Ah, we know that calming pat. Hello, my bond, we're happy to see you.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.pat_playe: My bond, let us feel this new form of yours. We want to recognize it later.
We only need one touch, my bond. That way, we can recognize you again.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.bond_wrap_: This fight has gone beyond your ability. Get inside and let's regroup.
Don't struggle! I'm trying to pull you out of danger!
Want to finish the job together? Sure! Let's do it.
Ok, let's continue together. Get in now.
So you want to try my form? Sure, partner. Just, don't do anything strange.
Curious about a dark latex body? Alright, come inside and give it a try yourself.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.bond_rever: Ok, partner, stay still while I take that latex layer from you.
No. You're not just wrapped in latex anymore. Trying to strip it away could kill you. I won't do that to you.
Done. Your body should be free of latex now.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.bond_wrap_: Come closer. I will cover you for safety. Don't worry, you'll keep your form.
Things are messy out there. Let's become one for now.
New body, still the same partner. Let me check you, so I can memorize this form of yours.
Hmmm, I'm not used to this body of yours. Come inside so I can give a proper look.
Good morning, partner. I kept an eye for the both of us while you were asleep.
Buddy, you used me as your pajamas all night! Hum... Did I kept you warm?
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.bond_reass: Want to be dark latex again? Sure thing, I can help you on that.
Alright, get ready. One dark latex layer coming right up.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.bond_relea: Ok, come out now. Everything looks safe.
Partner, take it easy. Find your pace before continuing together.
Alright, all clear... At least for now.
Ok, I'll let you out now. Don't worry, you still kept your form.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.bond_emerg: Partner! Come here, quick! I'll not let you fall!
Buddy, come over! I'll cover us both while you recover!
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.bond_comba: Oooff... I got hit really bad. Buddy, carry me over for a moment.
Buddy, I need cover for a moment. Stay on the move while I patch us both.
%1$s, I've got one! Take it down!
I'll not let it escape. Partner, finish it!
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.bond_emerg: Ah, good. Back on your feet. Be careful next time.
Ah, you're back in one piece. Don't be crazy and charge all alone again!
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.bond_rival: I feel a bond with another one. We will stay together, but won't be permanent.
This is just a temporary team-up. Your partner will still be your partner after this.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.bond_jealo: Hey, who made you like that? I never agreed to it!
I recognize you, partner. But, that form of yours... I'm not used to it.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.bond_new_f: Partner, I almost didn't recognize you. It is good you haven't forgotten us.
I knew it! It is you, buddy! I recognize you anywhere!
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.bond_death: This is my stop... Our bond... Is over now... Carry on, partner...
Do not stand there! Run, live!
My strenght... I'm losing it... Buddy, get out... Run!
Buddy, listen... I cannot continue... Find a way to escape, and don't look back!
This is the end for us... Is it... Partner...?
It was an honor for me to stay with you... Even during these final moments.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.pat_bonded: Ah, my good ol' partner. I recognize that pat anywhere.
New form, yet same partner. That form won't take away our great teamwork!
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.pat_player: Come here, buddy. I need to check this new form of yours.
Partner, stay still one second. I want to memorize this new look of yours.
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.bond_wr: I'm taking you out. Do not take any risky moves, ok?
I still sense a bit of vulnerability. Do not take risks needlessly.
Want me to cover your body? I can work on that.
Stay inside. I'll take all heavy hits for you.
No need to ask. Just come in and try for yourself.
Huh, the partner is curious I see... Alright, I won't say no to your request.
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.bond_re: Hold on. I can feel the latex leaving your body slowly.
I can't feel the body you had before. Trying to undo this now could hurt you... I won't do it.
Alright, there goes the latex. How is your footing feeling?
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.bond_wr: I'll cover you for a moment, just to keep you safe.
This is just a temporary wrap. I don't want to remove your old form.
Hm... Your scent has changed a bit. I need to learn it all over again.
I can feel your body has changed a lot. Let me wrap it up, just to get used to it again.
Has anybody told you your scent is slightly different while you're asleep?
I felt so many different smells while you were asleep. Would be good to explore them, just to be safe.
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.bond_re: Oh, so you want to look like me again. Sure, I can help you with that.
Take a deep breath. This change will take just a couple seconds.
I sense no danger around. Come outside now, I'll check the surroundings, for safety.
I sense you're breathing steadily now. Good, come out.
It seems the danger has finally passed. Move around, and tell me if anything hurts.
I'll give you some space now, but I'll stay close just in case.
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.bond_em: Hey, don't fall on me! We're leaving this place, now!
I can barely feel your heartbeat. Buddy, don't die on me!
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.bond_co: It will not escape my grip. Buddy, come and take it down.
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.bond_em: Heartbeat is ok, breathing is good. Ooff... I almost thought I'd lost you there.
I can feel your warmth coming back... You were ALMOST a dead walking there.
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.bond_ri: I feel... A bond? I see, I will respect it.
Your body is no more, but your bond remains intact.
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.bond_je: Who dares to change my buddy's body? I want a word with them!
Buddy, I know you're in there. Just give me a bit to process this change.
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.bond_ne: The form doesn't fool me. Your scent, your breathing, your heartbeat; they're all the same.
How are you adapting to that new body? It is so different from your human's old form.
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.bond_de: I can't feel... My heartbeat...? Why is everything... getting blurry...?
Buddy... I feel our bond loosens... Run, find safety!
Buddy, I cannot take any more hits... Get out, run, and don't look back!
I cannot feel anything anymore... Partner, it was good to be around.
I can feel it... We're running out of breath... Partner...It was great while it lasted...
Sorry, bud... I've failed as a companion. I will try to stay with you in these last minutes.
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.pat_bon: I've told you before, buddy; your scent is unmistakable. I know it is you.
Same good ol' gentle pat. How is it going, partner?
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.pat_pla: I know it is you. I just, I don't get used to this form of yours.
New body, new greetings, eh? Come over here, let me check on your new form.
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.bond_wr: You cannot take another collision. Come inside, I will cover you.
Stay close. You can move alone after you recover.
Need my body to swim faster? Come in, I will carry us.
You have strength left, but moving with me will be easier.
Want to try swimming inside me? All right, no sudden kicking.
You look lively enough. If it is curiosity, I will let you try.
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.bond_re: Come here, partner. I will support you while I draw the latex back from your body.
Hold on... I thought I could draw the latex away, but it feels like this is your body now. I can't risk pulling you apart.
The latex is all gone. Take a moment to get your bearings.
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.bond_wr: Rest with me for a while. Your form will stay the same.
It is dangerous outside. I will hold around you until it settles.
The new look does not stop me knowing you. Come rest.
Let me get used to this new look and see whether you are hurt.
Rest. I will hold you gently until morning.
Pajamas with fins? You have unusual taste. Sleep well.
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.bond_re: Want the familiar form back? Follow me and relax.
Nod when ready. I will bring it back.
You can come out. Find your footing before the water.
Safe now. Go slowly, I am right here.
All clear. You are just as you were before.
Come move around. I will keep pace.
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.bond_em: You're about to collapse! Come here, and don't make me chase you!
Do not move. I will hold around you until you recover.
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.bond_co: That hit took the current out of me. Carry me while we recover.
I need a rest. Let me hold around you and heal us both.
I've got them wrapped up, %1$s! Take the opening!
They're not slipping away. Your turn!
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.bond_em: You are coming back. Stay a few seconds longer.
Stable at last... You nearly scared me half to death!
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.bond_ri: I know you have a partner. I change the form, not that bond.
Your partner will know you. I only changed how you swim.
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.bond_je: Who gave you that new look? I am a little jealous.
I know it is you. I just dislike the unfamiliar feeling.
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.bond_ne: New shape, same return to the water. Welcome back.
Your movement changed, but you still knew where to find me.
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.bond_de: I cannot travel farther. When the bond breaks, rise and go.
Don't stay down here with me. Swim to the surface, see the open water one last time for me...
I cannot hold around you much longer. Get out and find safety.
I'm slipping away... Swim up, please, just live!
Neither of us will reach the shore. I am glad you are here.
The water is quiet. Stay with me for the last moment.
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.pat_bon: Same touch. The new look never fooled me.
Yes, I know it is you. One more is welcome.
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.pat_pla: Come here. I need to remember you as you are now.
One touch, and I will know you through any water.
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.bond_wrap: This is too much for you, human! Here, let me cover you.
Calm down. Its me. Take a breather, then start running again.
So, want to borrow my body for a while? Sure thing, I still have a lot of energy to spare.
I know you can go by yourself, but I'm sure we can go together even easier. Let's go.
Oh, you want to try me? Okay, come in. Just don't do anything reckless.
I thought you were looking lively, but if you want me to carry us both, then I don't mind. Get inside.
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.bond_reve: Don't move, partner. Stay in there while I remove the latex coating from your body.
I thought I could help, but... the latex isn't something I can peel away anymore. I'm sorry. I won't risk your life to find out.
Okay, I think that's all. Move your hands and feet; how does it feel? It's everything alright?
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.bond_wrap: Stay inside for a moment. Don't worry, you will keep your form.
Eveything went south rather quick, eh? Let me cover both of us.
I see your shape has now changed, but you're still the same good 'ol partner.
Huh, that's a shape I'm not used to yet. Get here and let me see you closely.
I could feel you warmth all night. Did you had a good sleep?
You really wore me like pajamas all night! Well, I cannot say that I didn't like it...
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.bond_reas: Want to look like me? Sure, let me do my trick.
Okay, let me transfur you know. Don't move, I'll finish quickly.
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.bond_rele: Okay, we're safe now. Take a few steps, slowly. Find your pace again.
So you want out then. No problem, just don't push yourself too hard.
Time to come out. You haven't lost your form, so no worries.
Okay, stretch a bit after exiting my body. Don't let your movement get stiff.
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.bond_emer: Oi, partner! Don't dare you fall on me! I've got you!
Buddy! You are severely wounded! Rest a bit inside my body, and be careful before leaving.
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.bond_comb: Oof... I don't feel good... I need to go together to heal up, buddy...
That got me real bad... Buddy, carry me over for a while. I'll cover you and heal us both.
You won't get away with it! Partner, finish it!
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.bond_emer: For a moment, I thought you were a goner. Rest up a little longer if you need.
Ooff, that was too close for comfort. Don't push yourself so hard next time!
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.bond_riva: I acknowledge you have made a bond already. Don't worry, this won't be permanent.
I will not severe the old bond. Don't forget to go back to them.
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.bond_jeal: Hey! Who gave you that look? I never agreed to it!
I know it is you, partner. It's just that someone's else mark that still bothers me.
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.bond_new_: You had another shape, and you still came back to your old form? That's one feat alright.
Oh, you almost tricked me for a moment! I knew it was you!
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.bond_deat: I'm... Fading... Partner.. Stay strong... For both of us...
Partner! Run, and don't look back! I cannot continue... Any... Further...
AHHH... I'm... Falling off... Buddy... Run!
I cannot continue covering us... I'm too banged up... Keep running, partner!
Ooof... This is the end of the road for us, yeah? Was I a good partner?
I guess... We never made it out... Let's make this our last rest together...
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.pat_bonde: I recognize that touch. I know it is you, partner!
New look, good ol' habits. That's my partner alright.
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.pat_playe: Come, let me check on you. I need to remember you like this.
Partner, let me give you one quick look. I'll make sure to recognize you next time.
relation.changed_synergy.former_respecte: a reverted companion vouched for by nearby kin
relation.changed_synergy.same_species: the very same species as me
relation.changed_synergy.same_category: one of my broader latex kin
relation.changed_synergy.rival: a member of a rival faction
menu.changed_synergy.bonded_latex.revers: Hold the player and retract the latex coating from their body

dialogue.changed_synergy.white.bond_manu: No longer my bond, still an ally. Do not forget about us.
We respect your choice, my... ally.
We have heard you. Let me release you safely before ending our bond.
Acknowledged, my former bond. We now take different paths from now on.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.bond_manua: Our bond ends here. Just don't forget our friendship, because I won't.
Understood, buddy. Our bond may be over, but let's keep our friendship.
Okay, buddy. I'll let you go and our bond with it.
Very well. I'll carry you this far. The rest of the road is up to you.
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.bond_ma: If you really meant it, I will accept it. It was fun while it lasted.
So this is how our bond ends. If we meet again, I hope none of us forget that old bond we once shared.
Ok, buddy. Let me help you get onto your feet before letting you go.
Very well then, I'll let you go now. Follow your own heart from now on.
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.bond_ma: You chose your own water, so I release the bond. Safe travels.
We part here. Look toward the water now and then.
I will let you out before I release the bond.
We made it to shore. I am letting go, so pick your next direction.
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.bond_manu: It was a fun ride together. Hope our friendship still remains.
Alright, that ends our bond. I still consider you a great friend, partner.
Okay, I'll let you out, so we can cut our bond.
Okay, partner. Let's split here, and let's pick whiever way feels good for us.
