dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.organic: *CHOMP... Ha! Now we wait for it to take effect.
This will sting at first, but trust me; you'll like it once done.
Got you! Oh, you thought your form will keep you safe? You're so naive...
No need to panic. You're already a transfurred beast, so a change of form won't be any different for you.
Got you! That's all that is needed for the change.
And that's a hit! Can you feel it human? Your body is already changing...
Even your form won't help you in this.
You tried, and you failed. With one scratch, you'll be like me in no time.
I've got you now! Now, calm down, match my breathing, and don't twist yourself.
Hey, quit struggling. I don't want to hurt you, but I won't let you go yet.
You're pinned! Ooof... You're strong indeed!
Let's play a game now; let's see how long that form of yours holds.
And, done! Told you, your form won't help you. Don't worry, I'll help you get used to this new form.
And you thought a second assimilation was not possible. Now move a bit, and try taking a few steps.
Oh? I feel another's scent. Very well, I will not sever that bond.
Now, go back to your partner. Show him this new body of yours.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.bond_drow: I feel you're drowning! My bond, stick to us!
Save your breath. Let me carry us to the surface, my bond.
My bond, I feel your lungs getting fresh air now. Good. Don't scare us like that!
That was too close. My bond, call us when you are taking such dangerous underwater trips.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.bond_drown: Buddy! Come in! You're out of air!
Don't go down, go up! You'll drown if you continue!
Ahhh!!! I almost lost you down there. Take a big mouthful of fresh air.
You almost drown. Buddy, don't be that reckless ever again!
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.bond_dr: Hey! Hold onto me! Don't run dry on oxygen!
Ooofff... Your breathing was so off down there. Don't scare me like that again.
Ah, I feel your heartbeat getting back to normal. That's good, but please wait a bit before diving again.
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.bond_dr: You are out of air! Come here, I have you.
No deeper. Get inside and breathe.
You are back. Swim slower for a while.
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.bond_drow: Partner! You are almost out of air! Get right here before you drown!
Got you. Stay inside, so you won't drown that quick.
Can you breath, buddy? Ooof... You almost drown there. Don't be so reckless next time!
That was really close. Don't try anything this dumb again, yes?
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.disguise_d: I... Huh? Wait, do I know you?
Oh... Are you new? Welcome! Come over and help me.
You must be new around. Alright, we have room for one more in our ranks.
Hm? Hold on... Hm.... Ok, move along.
Something's not right here. Am I imagining things?
Wait, you look a little funny... Can I check your mask?
Hey! That's not one of us! Get him!
Wha... A FAKE MASK?! STOP HIM!
I knew this mask was a fluke! I won't let you get away with it!
Ouch! Hey, you're not one of us! Chase him!
You slipped into our ranks... To ambush us? You'll pay for that!
... So that's your true self. You're bold, or mad.
Aha! So you decided to drop the act. You'll have to come with me.
Your mask fell off! Wait... Human? You better start running now!
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.disguise_: Hsss! Back off, you filthy... Huh?
We recognize that mask of yours. We will take you out!
A dark latex dares come this close? We won't let you go!
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.pat_disgui: Are you one of those rookies? I do not recognize that greeting.
That's one odd greeting. Are all the new recruits like this?
I just wanted to be sure everything is fine. Don't worry, carry on.
Good, now we've met each other.
You thought a pat would sell that act? Not a chance!
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.pat_disgu: We don't approve that disguise of yours. Do not touch us using it.
Don't try to act friendly. That disguise has us all on high alert.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.pat_player: Hey, don't be a stranger. Come say hello!
Hey, rookie. Don't dodge me. We greet our own around here.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.spotted_h: We feel it... A human among us...
A real human, here? We haven't felt this in years!
We knew it was a human the moment you came in. Don't be afraid; it has been just too long.
Is that a human? We never expected to see one out here.
Human, where did you come from? We want to know more about you.
We all know you are here. Why don't you answer our questions?
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.spotted_t: An outsider has come to our home. Don't scare him away.
We see you. If you mean no harm, we won't attack you.
We've never seen that form before. Are you lost?
Hello, stranger. We're just passing by. We meant no harm.
We see you, stranger. If you're friendly, we'll get along.
We don't recognize that form, but you seem friendly. We don't mind your company.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.meet_spec: We felt one of us really close. Welcome, my kind.
A familiar feel alright. Come in, we welcome you.
We knew there was one of us around here. Come, travel with us.
Ah, one of us! We are happy to meet a familiar face around.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.meet_cate: A familiar face, yet not my species. Still one of us.
We acknowledge you're not exactly one of us, yet you're kin. We accept your company.
A kin far away is good company for us. Come, let's travel together.
We feel we're not the same. Still, you are one of us.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.meet_frie: We sense a friendly scent. Please come in, we won't attack you.
Not one of us, but one of our friends. Welcome.
We're happy to see a friendly face so far from home. We enjoy your company.
A friendly face away from home is always a nice surprise.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.meet_riva: Stop. Your kind is not welcome here. Go back where you came from!
We feel an unpleasant presence. Continue further, and accept the consequences.
We don't want to fight unnecessary battles. Back off while you can.
We expected encounters with other creatures, but you? Keep your distance and we'll be fine.
We respect other's territory, so we won't start a fight. Keep moving.
We are not wasting our trip fighting you. Stay back.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.meet_outs: We sense you're not kin, but that's alright. Keep it friendly and we'll get along.
We welcome you, outsider. If you mean no harm, we won't trouble you.
We do not recognize your face. What is the reason of your visit?
Ah, hello, stranger. We're just passing by.
An unknown face to us. We suppose you mean no harm, yes?
Hello, new face. Want to continue your way, or walk together with us for a bit?
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.spotted_hu: There's a human in our territory. Everyone, get ready, and close all escape routes!
A real human! Stay alert, I'll make first contact.
Years without seeing a human, and out of nowhere one is in our turf. Bold... I like that.
Human spotted. Stay on guard; let's watch him closely.
Such a place for a human to show. Coming here was worth it!
Huh? Am I dreaming? A human? Here of all places?
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.spotted_tr: Outsider at 12 o'clock. Hold your positions. Let's see if it is friendly.
An unfamiliar face, eh? Play nice and we'll play nice too, got it?
Hey, new face. We're always watching. Don't try anything stupid.
An outsider! Don't swing at it yet. No need to ask for uncalled trouble.
Hey, outsider, you are entering our turf. Behave, and we'll be fine, understood?
You... If you want to talk, that's fine. Just don't start trouble.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.meet_speci: Ah, one just like me. I don't mind you giving me a hand.
I recognize that shape anywhere. Come in, we're in familiar ground.
One similar as me. Good news! Watch my back, please.
Ah, a fellow compatriot. Come with us, our squad won't mind having one more.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.meet_categ: You're different, yet very familiar. I welcome you nonetheless.
You move like one of us, yet you look so different. Are you friendly?
A fellow companion. Walk with me; the trip will be more interisting with you around.
You look oddly familiar. I can even feel you're one of us.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.meet_frien: Any friend of mine can come in. Stay close and don't go asking for trouble.
Not kin, but I think we can work together. A pair of extra eyes can help me.
Ah, friend of mine. Let's follow the road ahead together.
Not one of us, but one I can call friend anyway.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.meet_rival: The others have arrived. Stay on guard, don't engage in battle yet.
This is our territory. Don't make any sudden movements or we'll engage.
You dare to come to our door? Fine, then be ready to face the consequences.
Today we meet in the road. If you attack, we'll attack as well, don't forget it!
We're not looking for trouble, but we're ready to end anything you start.
I recognize that stench. Keep your distance from us.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.meet_outsi: An outsider in our turf I see. Don't cause trouble and we'll be fine.
You may be not kin, but long as you keep things friendly, we won't trouble you.
Hey, stranger. As long as you follow the rules, we'll be all fine.
Hello, stranger. We're just passing by, we don't want any trouble.
Mmmm I sense no hostility, for now at least. Good, let's keep it friendly.
The road's wide enough. You go your way and we'll go ours.
dialogue.changed_synergy.personality.cur: I want to see where you are running away to
Keep running. I want to see how you try to escape me.
You were around here. Let me think... where are you hiding?
Nothing over there. Let me try another direction.
I haven't met anyone like you ever. Let me get a better look at you...
Wait. You're quite interesting.
You're back. I never asked you all my questions.
I remember you. What have you seen out there?
Oh? I'm not sure how to feel about that.
So that's your way of greeting someone?
Don't jump. I just want to see your reaction.
Well, that wasn't the reaction I expected.
What did you hit me for?
Was that on accident, or did you do it purposefully?
dialogue.changed_synergy.personality.cau: Hands up. Keep your hands where I can see them.
I won't run straight in. Don't try anything clever.
Lost the trail. I'll check close by...
Something is wrong. Are you waiting for me?
Stay right there. Let me get a clear look before you approach.
Don't run at me like that. Let me get used to you.
It's you. I know who's coming this time.
I remember your face. You can come closer, slowly.
Gentle. I'm not quite comfortable with this yet.
You may continue, just don't press without a warning.
Don't jump. I'll only touch you softly.
Step away if you dislike it. I won't keep reaching out to you.
Back off. I have to be aware of you now.
Do that again and I won't let it slide.
dialogue.changed_synergy.personality.pro: Stop there. Don't get the others into trouble.
You'll have to try harder to get past me.
I won't risk the safety of the pack just to chase you.
You better keep away from them.
Move gently. Don't startle the others around us.
Behave yourself and I won't bring trouble.
It's you. Stay close, the others know you by now.
Good, you're back. You're safe with us.
Alright, I'm here. Tell me if anything brings trouble.
Don't worry about the area. I'm keeping watch.
Hold still. Let me see if you're hurt.
There, you're fine. Stay with me.
Don't make me fight in front of my companions.
Fight me if you must. Just keep the others out of it.
dialogue.changed_synergy.personality.sho: Watch me closely. I know many ways of catching you.
Come on, run faster. Don't let me catch up to you as soon as I start running.
Enjoy your head start. I'll be able to find you in no time.
A half-decent hiding place won't stop me from finding you.
Good timing. I'm about to show off my tricks, that means I could use an audience.
Take another look. I'm looking stylish today.
You returned to see me? You got taste.
What a perfect timing. Want to see the new thing I learned?
Watch it, you'll spoil the pose I worked on passionately.
Finally, you noticed me.
See? I can do this as well.
Let me try. My technique is better than you think.
That's all you got? I expected more.
You don't have to hit me like that to get my attention.
dialogue.changed_synergy.personality.cal: Take your time. I don't need to hurry.
You don't have to panic. I'll keep up.
They hid? They will move if I don't.
I'll slow down and listen for them. Going too fast will only scare them.
If you come in peace, you can stay here.
You don't have to be nervous. We will leave you in peace.
I remember you. Stay for a while if you like.
There you are. You seem more at ease than last time I saw you.
Hm, that feels nice.
You don't have to stop. It doesn't bother me.
Stay calm. I'm only saying hi.
Don't tense up. I won't press much.
Please stop. This doesn't have to end in a fight.
I'll put this behind us if you stop now.
dialogue.changed_synergy.personality.com: Come on, let's see who loses this hunt.
Go all out. I hate to win easily.
You didn't win just because I lost track of you.
One step ahead of me? I will change that.
You look strong. We should test our strength sometime.
You move fast. I wonder just how fast...
Another challenge? I still recall the last one.
Great timing. I wanted to challenge you again.
Not a bad pat. Let me show you my technique.
That one earns you a point.
Your turn. See if you can beat my pats.
Don't dodge. I'm showing you how it's done.
If you want to fight, do it honestly.
Do that again and I'll retaliate. Don't complain afterward.
dialogue.changed_synergy.personality.pla: Run. I was looking for something to chase.
Run all around the place. Don't make the chase stale.
Nice hiding place. You almost got me.
Make yourself known. This chase is way too quiet.
You look interesting. That's good.
Since you're here, come run around with me.
You came by. I could use the company.
We meet again. Don't leave so quickly again.
That was a good one. Won't say no to another.
You found a good spot. well done.
Don't tense up. It's just a little pat.
Caught you off-guard, didn't I?
Hey, that's no fun.
Easy. I never said I wanted a fight.
dialogue.changed_synergy.personality.sen: Don't turn out of nowhere. I can hear your every step.
Slow down. You're making a lot of noise.
This silence is odd. You must still be nearby.
I heard movement over there.
Wait a second. I'm not used to your movements.
You're much louder than you think you are.
I know those footsteps. Glad to see you again.
I know you. You don't startle me anymore.
Gentle. Even a light touch may make me jump.
Go slowly and don't pull your hand away too fast.
You seemed tense. Does that help?
I'll only touch you once. I hope you don't get startled.
That hurt me more than you think.
Don't hit me without a warning. I remember things like that.
dialogue.changed_synergy.personality.cur: The touch was only meant to make me relax? I understand.
I figured you stopped. I got that wrong.
Again? No thank you. I already tried trusting you before.
I won't fall for that twice. Move your hand off me.
dialogue.changed_synergy.personality.cau: I shouldn't have relaxed so soon. Keep away.
I knew something was off. You won't be getting a second chance.
Keep your hands off me. I don't repeat my mistakes.
Stop there. I trusted you before. That was enough for you to use against me.
dialogue.changed_synergy.personality.pro: You used a cheap shot to get a free hit. Stay away from my companions.
Fight me if you must. Don't use that trick to fool the others.
Stay away from the pack. Reaching out now only puts our guard up.
I won't risk the safety of my companions again.
dialogue.changed_synergy.personality.sho: That trick won't work on me again.
Fine, you got your hit. I won't make it that easy next time you try.
This trick again? Against me? Please.
You caught me off guard last time. I'm ready for you now.
dialogue.changed_synergy.personality.cal: I offered to stop this. You were the one who continued.
I was going to let this slide. That has changed.
I won't just forget what happened all because of one touch. Step back.
Don't try to pat me. I no longer trust your intent with it.
dialogue.changed_synergy.personality.com: If you want to brawl, start it properly. Why are you pretending to stop?
You got a cheap shot on me. I'll show you what I've got, then.
Stop doing that, we are facing off.
Don't try to pause the battle. Put your hand away.
dialogue.changed_synergy.personality.pla: I thought you were trying to mend wounds. That's not fun.
You covered up a hit with a pat? Now you made me angry.
No. I won't play that game with you again.
Don't act all nice now. I remember that followed last time you did that.
dialogue.changed_synergy.personality.sen: You made me relax, then hit me. Don't touch me again.
I recall. You went for a pat, then punched me.
Don't reach out to me. I flinch when you touch me now.
Move your hand off me. I remember how you betrayed my trust.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.polite_no: We feel a human among us! I will talk first. Don't engage him.
Human, come closer. We haven't seen your kin in years. We want to talk.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.polite_pr: Human, we need to check on you. Do not move.
We need an answer from you, human. Are you friendly or hostile?
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.polite_re: Ah, good. Your intentions are not bad.
We have an agreement. Understood, we will remember this first greeting.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.polite_no: Hmmm... We still don't know you, but we will respect your space.
You still don't trust us. It's fair; We will give you space then.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.pat_playe: We can sense you, human. Can I still greet you like this?
Remember this greeting? This is how we met in the first place.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.polite_not: Everyone, stay alert! Human at 12 o'clock. I'll engange first.
Nobody move. I'll make first contact with the human.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.polite_pro: Human, give me your hand. I would like to see your true intentions.
Hey, human. If you're friendly, then greet me back.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.polite_res: Ah, I see you have good intentons. Good, I'll keep the others in check.
Nice greeting. Alright, carry on. We'll not chase the next time we see each other.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.polite_no_: Ok, I understand. I'll give you some space.
Uh? Still no trust? I mean, it's fine. I'll tell the others to not bother you.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.pat_player: Ah, my friend. Our last understanding still stands true.
Come human. Let me greet you properly.
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.polite_: Hmmm... Human scent? Unusual, but not hostile. Don't engage yet.
A human? Here? I need to meet them right away!
Human, please show me your hand. I want to know more about your scent.
Hello human. What are your intentions here? I may come closer if you answer accordingly.
Hm... Your scent, is polite. I'll make sure to remember you.
Ah, you answered my greeting. Don't worry, I will not forget this moment.
I see... Still afraid. I won't chase, but behave. That's all I ask.
Still wary I see. Fair game; get used to my scent first.
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.pat_pla: I still remember the first time we met. May I give you a pat like last time?
Let me see if you remember this greeting.
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.polite_: Wait, a human! Stop splashing. I want to approach on my own.
They're still here. Quiet. Let me come through the shallows first.
May I touch you? Lightly. I won't pull you into the water.
Just hold your hand near the surface. I'll come closer if you want.
You really answered. Next time, I'll call to you from the water.
Good. I'll remember you. There'll be room for you by the water.
That's all right. I'll go back to the shallows while you watch.
Still afraid of me? All right, I'll back away.
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.pat_pla: No need for another test. Come say hello.
I know you. Relax, I will not suddenly pull you away.
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.polite_no: Wait, that's a real human! Guys, stop! Let me greet it.
Don't chase it yet. We don't know if it is hostile. Let me say hello first.
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.polite_pr: Hello. Can I touch you? Just one simple touch.
Wait, please. let me remember what you look like.
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.polite_re: Ah, so you answered back! I welcome you then! Hope we can be friends!
I see, you are not hostile. I'll make sure to tell the resto so they wont attack you.
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.polite_no: No answer? Fine, I suppose. I won't chase, just be careful out there.
Uh, I guess you still afraid of me. Okay, I understand. I'll be gentler next time.
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.pat_playe: I know who you are. Don't worry, it's just a pat.
No need to dodge this time. I'm only greeting you, not transfurring you.
dialogue.changed_synergy.personality.pol: I asked for you to stop. I will have to chase you now.
Stop there and we can still talk it out.
Don't make me search everywhere. Please come out.
I still need an answer from you. Stop hiding.
I'll stay here. You can choose to come closer if you want.
Let's greet each other so neither of us gets startled.
I remember you. It's safe to come closer.
We meet again. No need for another test, I know you by now.
Thanks. That was nice.
That's nice. We can chill out.
Stay a second. I'll only touch you gently.
I will be soft. You don't need to dodge.
I just wanted to say hello. Why did you hit me?
Stop. If that was by mistake, I can forgive you.
You accepted my friendliness, then used that to hit me. I'll remember that.
If you seek a fight, make it clear. Don't hide it behind kindness.
No. I know you will pretend to show kindness again.
Please step back. I made myself clear last time.
dialogue.changed_synergy.personality.cur: Hold still. I want to see the latex leaving you.
I'm not familiar with doing this. Come closer and keep still.
dialogue.changed_synergy.personality.cau: Don't move suddenly. Let me hold you firmly, then I'll draw the latex back.
Stand still. I don't want to hurt you.
dialogue.changed_synergy.personality.pro: Come here. I'll hold you steady so you don't stumble when you change back.
Come closer. I'll get a firm grasp on you before I draw the latex back.
dialogue.changed_synergy.personality.sho: Watch me. I promise to have you come back exactly as you were before.
Piece of cake. Come here and I'll have you changed back in no time.
dialogue.changed_synergy.personality.cal: Don't rush it. Come closer and breathe steadily.
Stay calm. I'll draw the latex back carefully.
dialogue.changed_synergy.personality.com: I concede this time. Come here. I'll draw back every bit of my latex.
Fine, you convinced me this time. Hold steady.
dialogue.changed_synergy.personality.pla: Deal. One last hug, then I'll let you go.
Don't run away. Come here. This won't take long.
dialogue.changed_synergy.personality.sen: I'm sorry, you didn't want this. Come closer. I'll be gentle.
It's fine. I get it. Once you're ready, I'll let you go.
dialogue.changed_synergy.personality.pol: We have settled on that. Please come closer and I'll release you.
Alright. I respect your decision. Please hold still for a moment.

dialogue.changed_synergy.white.spotted_h: We sense... a human... We need answers from it.
Wait. Let us see you, human. We want to know more about you.
It's been years since we last saw a human. Please, don't run, let's talk instead.
A human... Don't run from us, hear the noise yourself.
We have felt your warmth before. Human, be one with us.
We... no... I can hear a voice... It tells me you must be my host!
Human... Be one of us. Don't be a stranger anymore.
Ah, please don't run. We all want to know what you'll be like among us.
Human, come over. Come hear all this noise for yourself.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.spotted_hu: is that a human? A real human?! Wait! Let's talk! Don't run!
Don't chase it! I've waited too long to scare a human off the moment I start talking...
New face? No, that's actually a face I've never seen in years!
Everyone, stand back! Human, could you become my host?
Don't run! I've waited so long for this opportunity, I won't damage you.
Human, you have everyone on high alert. Come over, and let us greet the others, together!
Hey, listen, human! I don't want to hurt you, please join us!
It's been so long since a new member began as human! Come over, mate!
Stay with us, human. Everyone here will protect you.
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.spotted: Your scent... I've only found it in long forgotten places. May I see you clearly?
Please don't hide. I just want to talk. I have so many questions...
Ah, so this is how a living human looks. Let me check you carefully.
I need to know how a human becomes one of us. Please, let me do it.
I know humans are rare, but I want to understand you better. Be one of us, please!
I have ever wondered how you humans change... This is a golden chance!
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.spotted: From the shore... a real human. Don't go yet. Let me hear your voice.
I haven't seen a reflection like yours in years. Will you come closer?
Everyone stay back. I want the first word with this human.
That warmth stands out... let me come closer. Don't be afraid.
Half the water is already watching. Would you become my host?
Don't leave the shore. I finally found someone I want to approach.
It's been years since the water welcomed someone who began human.
Don't fear the water. If you stay, everyone will remember today.
Come closer. I want you to hear the sudden noise beneath the surface.
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.spotted_h: Wow, a real human... Don't jump in! Let me look at it properly.
Hmmm, that smell... That's a human smell. I need to greet it!
No pouncing! I saw him first, so I get to greet him.
I knew it was worth coming over. Hey, human, please be my host!
Please, don't run! It's been too long since I found a smell that fits this well!
Hey, human! Don't run! I want to go with you, not hurt you!
Is that a human? Hey, human! Become a member of our pack, so I will know your scent anywhere!
Oh? A chase? I'm in! Let's see how fast my future clanmate can go.
Human, stop! Please don't go! An encounter like this shouldn't go to waste.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.relations: You can call me %3$s, %1$s. We are glad to have an ally in you.
%2$s, from now on, you can call me %3$s. No need to run if you see me.
%3$s. That is my name. We are now acquainted, %1$s.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.social_ta: We sense your interests in shiny blue rocks. We can help you find them.
We can feel you are more relaxed. That makes us happy.
We don't sense any danger, but please, don't lower your guard.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.social_pa: Hm... We are enjoying that greeting.
We still recognize your warm touch. Still very gentle.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.social_fo: Understood. You lead, we will follow.
Lead. We will be right behind you.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.social_wa: We will be waiting for your return.
Alright. We will be around, awaiting for you.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.social_go: We bid you farewell. Be safe.
No need to rush. You don't always have to run away.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.relationsh: All right, %2$s. I'm %3$s. My pleasure to finally meet you.
Now we're acquainted, %1$s. %3$s, that's my name, do not forget about me.
Well met, my friend. I'm %3$s. I'll make sure to remember your face.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.social_tal: What do you have in mind? I'm listening.
Things look pretty calm today. That's good news, right?
I've heard that white latexes smell funny. What do you think?
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.social_pat: Eh, I don't know why the sudden pat, but I gladly take it!
Ah, nice greeting. Has someone told you that your hand is very soft?
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.social_fol: Alright buddy, go on ahead. I'll be right behind you.
Let's go. I'll follow up close.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.social_wai: Ok, understood. I'll wait for you around.
Got it. Please, don't take too long.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.social_goo: See you later. Eyes on the road.
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.relatio: I'm %3$s, %1$s. I remember your hand and your scent too.
%2$s, remember %3$s. You will not need to hide next time.
You touched me first, so you get my name. %3$s. We are friends now.
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.social_: I feel... your heart is racing... Were you doing some exercise lately?
Some unusual scent is surrounding you. Where were you?
I don't mind taking a quick rest here. I'm in no hurry.
Ah, I truly enjoy those pats of yours.
I could recognize a friend touch anywhere.
Understood. I'll follow your scent, wherever you go.
Go on. I'll catch up quickly.
Ok, I'll be around. I'll catch your scent quickly if anything happens.
Alright, just don't forget about me.
Very well, smell ya later!
Be careful out there. Don't go getting hurt yourself.
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.relatio: Call me %3$s, %1$s. Use that name by the water next time.
Now we know each other, %2$s. I'm %3$s, so you do not need to hide.
You have my name, %1$s. It is %3$s. I will find you first next time.
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.social_: Anything new happening on shore today?
Good timing. I just heard something moving below.
Stand closer. I don't want to call across the whole bank.
Mm. Your hand is still warm.
Just don't splash water everywhere.
Stay near the water and I'll keep up faster.
Lead on. I can manage the shore.
I'll wait nearby. The water will keep me company.
All right, I won't follow. Call when you return.
See you. Don't show off in deep water.
Go on. Bring me some news from shore next time.
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.relations: Alright, %2$s. My name is %3$s. I will not chase you the next time I see you, promise.
From now on, we're friends, %1$s. Call me %3$s. Don't you forget my name, okay?
Understood. I see you're not a prey, but an ally instead. I am %3$s, I hope we can be good friends.
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.social_ta: Hmmm, you got smells on you I don't follow. You travelled a lot last time, don't you?
The coast's clear. You can relax here with me.
Ah, you're back, human! Found anything good this time?
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.social_pa: Hmm, that's a familiar greeting there.
I don't mind being greeted like this all day.
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.social_fo: Want me to follow then? Sure thing, lead the way!
Understood. Just don't take the long road on purpose.
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.social_wa: Okay, I'll be around. Don't take too long.
Alright, I'll check the surroundings, just in case.
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.social_go: Alright, see you later! Bring me something next time we meet!
See you, buddy. Be careful out there.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.relations: We are still learning your scent. Give us a little more time.
We can feel you're more familiar than before.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.relationsh: I remember you, yet not quite enough. I still need to watch a bit longer.
I'm starting to feel I can actually trust you.
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.relatio: Hmmm... I'm starting to recognize that scent of yours little by little.
I am intrigued on what your next move will be.
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.relatio: You're more familiar this time. Scents in the water don't lie.
I remember these hands. I just need a little longer.
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.relations: The more greets we make to each other, the easier it is for me to recognize you.
Ah, so that's your scent. Well, half of it, at least.
message.changed_synergy.social.no_gift: Hold the item you want to give, then sneak-right-click to open the social wheel.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.relations: Ah, oranges. We truly enjoy those fruits.
You remembered to bring food. Good. We'll remember this act of kindness.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.social_gi: You brought something for us? We appreciate it. We'll keep it safe
We thank you. We are glad you haven't forgotten about us.
You decided to be hostile. A simple gift won't solve this problem.
We are still feeling the wound you left on us. Take back that gift.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.relationsh: Oh, for me? I truly appreciate it.
Ah, I gladly take this gift. It's better than a simple greeting.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.social_gif: Ah, is that for me? Thank you so much!
That's a nice gift. I knew you knew I wanted this.
Nope, that won't work on me. Your fault, not mine
A gift you say? Nice try. Let's settle our problems first.
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.relatio: Ah, a fresh food. I appreciate it.
Neither too acidic, nor too sweet. Just right.
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.social_: A gift? Sure, I'll take it. I can still smell your scent on it.
I actually needed this. Thank you very much.
I still smell hostility in you. Take back that fake peace offering.
I'm still taking care of the damage you caused. Don't get close to me.
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.relatio: Fruit from shore? Let me taste it.
I can still smell it in the water. I'll remember this.
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.social_: Let me see it before you drop it in the water.
I'll take it. Next time, I'll find you something from below.
The water still carries what happened. Take it back.
Give me some space. I won't take it now.
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.relations: An orange? Sure thing. I was getting hungry.
Make sure to bring food with you next time we meet. That way, I can remember you a little easier.
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.social_gi: Oh, is that for me? I gladly take it!
Hm, hm, hm. That hit the spot. You're really good at choosing foods alright.
Take that food out of my face! I remember what you did to me last time.
I refuse to accept that from YOU. I haven't forgotten our last encounter.
message.changed_synergy.social.rest_busy: It is not safe enough to rest here.
message.changed_synergy.social.rest_cool: You can rest together again in %1$s seconds.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.social_re: Come closer. Let us share a resting moment with you.
Rest. We'll keep guard to prevent danger.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.social_res: This is a nice place to rest. Let's take a breather here.
Ok, let's check our wounds first, then we move.
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.social_: Good. Let's take a quick breather. I'll stick next to you.
Ok, let's stop one second. Wounds heal better if we stay still for a moment.
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.social_: Lean against me and breathe slowly.
Stay here. The water will cover our noise.
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.social_re: Okay, let's take a breather. There's no rush or anything.
Inhale. Exhale. Catch your breath before continuing.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.social_ta: We still feel pain. Yet, this pain is not enough to slow us down.
We are fine. However, we would appreciate a bit of resting.
We feel your pain. We think a rest would be suitable now.
Do not try to act tough, human. We all can hear your uneven breathing.
The rain... We enjoy the rain's noise. It gives us calm...
Come closer. We know getting wet is harmless, but we don't want you to catch a cold.
We feel a lot of movement. Still, we all are listening to keep you safe.
Still awake? Then let's keep watch together.
Whenever you are around, everyone feels more comfortable.
We do not need any subject. We feel better with your mere presence.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.social_pl: Ah, a race. Sure. We are glad to take a challenge from you.
We wonder... Can you keep up with us?
Everyone is watching. Come have some fun.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.social_tal: Oh, this? It's just a scratch. No need to worry.
It hurts, but I can still continue. Don't tell the others!
Partner, you can barely stand, and you're worried about talking? Let's check those wounds first.
Shush for a moment. Tend your wounds, then we can talk.
The rain is great to cover our footsteps. Now we can take a small rest.
Ugh... Rain makes my fur get all wet. I'm not a big fan of it.
You can take a quick nap if you want. I'll take the first shift.
It's too quiet... Buddy, don't lower your guard.
Uh, why are you sticking so close? Do I have something on my face?
It's great to have you around. Together, we can take anything that comes to us.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.social_pla: Want to race me? No excuses if you lose!
Alright, buddy. Let's see if you can keep up.
Sure, I could use the extra exercise. Pick a goal; let's see who gets there first.
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.social_: This? It hurts, yes. But it is not serious. Let's keep moving.
Ouch! Hey, that wound still hurts, you know!
I smell... blood? Don't you dare tell me it is nothing. Let me check it.
Your breathing... is uneven. Are you in pain?
Oh, I hate rain so much. It makes scents go away so quick.
Some of us hate the rain, but for some reason... It calms me.
You can't trust your eyesight during the night; trust your nose, your ears.
No need to worry; I can still feel any danger close, even if we can't see it.
I knew you were close. Your scent gives you away.
That heartbeat of yours is quite unique. It makes me happy to be close to you and hear it all day.
Let me check how fast you've become since our last chase.
Even if you hide, I can find you so easily. Your scent is... kind of strong.
Alright. Let's see who's the first to take down the next target.
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.social_: Give me a minute. Even the water cannot dull this ache.
Let me rest by the bank. We can talk when it eases.
Your breathing is wrong. Sit by the water. I am here.
Keep that wound out of the water. Come let me see it.
Every raindrop wakes the water. Can you hear it?
In weather like this, shore and water feel the same. Come closer.
Moonlight is on the water. Good night for a slow conversation.
Sound carries clearly across the water at night. You can speak softly.
When you come close, the water sounds familiar again. Welcome back.
Whichever way you come from, I always know your steps first.
Race along the bank? I am not giving you a head start.
Throw something into the water and I will fetch it. Keep it close.
Come on, one lap through the shallows. Least splashing wins.
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.social_ta: I've seen better days. I don't mind taking a quick break.
Hey, I may be banged up, but I can keep going.
I smell that wound of yours. Don't play though on me. I don't mind taking a rest.
Hey, partner, your steps are unsteady. You thought I wouldn't see that? A small rest won't do us any harm, yeah?
Ah... I really enjoy the rain. It's just a shame it can wash tracks from our preys.
What an unfortunate rain! It will make it harder for us to pinpoint our targets.
Nighttime is when things get actually interesting! Look, something moved over there!
Tired, buddy? No worries. Let's seat here. You can lean on me if you feel sleepy.
No need to be close to me. I knew it was you from miles away.
It's nice to have you around, specially since I don't have go out looking for you, hehe...
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.social_pl: Want to compete with me? Okay, what's the game?
Hey, don't just stay there, or I'll leave you behind!
dialogue.changed_synergy.personality.cur: Let's try doing something different. You go first, then I will copy.
I saw something moving over there. Want to see what it was?
dialogue.changed_synergy.personality.cau: We can play, don't jump at me out of nowhere.
Let's stay close together. I don't want to lose track of you.
dialogue.changed_synergy.personality.pro: Don't stray off too far. I can play whilst also watching our surroundings.
Sure, just stay where I can reach you.
dialogue.changed_synergy.personality.sho: Watch me close. I will only do this once.
I could use an audience. Great timing on your behalf.
dialogue.changed_synergy.personality.cal: You can go as fast as you like. A slower game works too.
We can stay here for a while and watch the surroundings.
dialogue.changed_synergy.personality.com: If you challenge me, be serious. I won't go easy on you.
Choose where we race to. Don't make excuses when you lose.
dialogue.changed_synergy.personality.pla: You finally want to play? Come catch me.
I have a game in mind we could play. Don't ask. Just follow what I'm doing.
dialogue.changed_synergy.personality.sen: Easy. I don't like sudden movements.
Sure, just tell me in which direction we are running.
dialogue.changed_synergy.personality.pol: Sure. What would you like to play?
We can play for a while. Just tell me when you're getting tired.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.relations: We recognize your food choice. We really appreciate such a gift.
Ah, more than just a simple orange this time we see. We thank you.
You even worked out our favorite food, %1$s? Then let us meet properly. I am %3$s.
Your food choice was flawless, %2$s. Call me %3$s, and we're glad to call you an ally.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.social_di: Thank you, %1$s. You really remembered what we like.
We never get tired of this delicious food. We thank you, %2$s
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.cat_orang: Hsss! We hate that dreadful smell!
Please, move that orange away. We despise such a terrible smell.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.friend_re: We trust your friend. Therefore, we trust you, for now.
Your friend vouched for you, so we will not chase. Come greet us.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.pat_frien: Your friend says you are ok. We acknowledge it, let us greet properly.
So these are the hands they have trusted. We understand now.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.pat_playe: No need to be afraid. Your friend is with you, we just want to say hello.
They are willing to trust you, and so are we. Come a little closer.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.compatrio: We feel our %1$s is being attacked. We must stop them!
Protect our %1$s first. Do not let that human get any closer again!
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.bond_witn: %2$s, stop! We demand an explanation on why you attacked our %3$s!
%1$s, stop, now! Why you raise arms against our %3$s?
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.friend_wi: %2$s, we all felt that. Stop attacking my %3$s, now!
Stop hurting my %3$s. If you continue, we will be forced to stop you.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.social_pl: %1$s, we agreed to play, so we want to start with a hug.
Got you, %2$s. Ah, don't worry, we are just giving you a friendly hug. We meant no harm.
%1$s, we feel the urge to hug you. Do not panic; it's just a friendly hug.
Got you, %2$s. We promise you, this will be just for a moment.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.relationsh: Hmmm... Excellent choice. Don't forget how much I like this food.
That hit the spot. Thanks for that!
You nailed my tastes, %2$s. From now on, I, %3$s, will be your friend.
That was delicious, %1$s. %3$s. That's my name. Don't forget it!
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.social_die: Great choice, %1$s. You really did remember my tastes.
Hm, it tastes amazing, %2$s. Where did you get those?
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.cat_orange: Ugh... Remove that thing from my nose. It itches!
Stop. I've only needed one sniff. It's too much!
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.friend_res: A friend of a friend. If they trust you, so I will.
Your friend stands with you, so we will give you space. Don't betray this trust.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.pat_friend: I see, your friend has spoken for you. Very well, I accept the greeting.
Keep your hand steady. Their trust is more valuable than you think...
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.pat_player: Do not worry. I respect your friend, so I won't do you any harm.
If they can greet you, then I want to greet you too!
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.compatriot: Our %1$s is under attack! Get over here, do not let them leave!
You dare attack our %1$s in front of us? Everyone, get 'em!
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.bond_witne: %1$s, are you crazy? That's my %3$s. Don't embarrass me here.
%2$s, look at me. Lower your hand and leave my %3$s alone.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.friend_wit: %2$s, I vouched for you, and now you are attacking my %3$s? Stop!
%1$s, is my trust so fragile to you? Stand back from my %3$s, now!
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.social_pla: Aha! Got you %1$s! You're not going anywhere.
That's my win. %1$s. My prize? I'll keep you hugged for a while.
Got you, %1$s! As punishment, I'll keep you grabbed for a moment.
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.relatio: This smells so good... How did you know I like this?
Ah, this tastes so good. You are taking the time to understand us, yeah?
You even know what I like to eat, %1$s? I am %3$s. We do not need to be strangers now.
%2$s, I will remember this food and you with it. Call me %3$s.
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.social_: Thank you, %1$s. I can smell that you chose this for me.
You still remember my taste, %2$s. Good.
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.cat_ora: Agh! That smell! Stings my nose so bad!
Ugh... I don't know what you have there, but it smells really bad.
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.friend_: I respect your friend, so I will not attack you.
I can clearly see the trust your friend has in you. Fine, I'll stand down.
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.pat_fri: I wonder... What did your friend see in you? I want to know.
I sense no hostility in you. It seems they judged you well.
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.pat_pla: Oh, please, don't back away. Your friend is watching, so no need to be afraid.
They recognize your scent, and I want to recognize it too. Please don't move.
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.compatr: You hurt my %1$s. Do not blame us for coming together.
They are bleeding. Stop that human before they touch the %1$s again.
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.bond_wi: Stop, %2$s. You are hurting my %3$s. I cannot ignore that.
%1$s, let go! Don't make me choose between you and %3$s.
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.friend_: %2$s, I called you a friend, and you hurt my %3$s? Enough.
%1$s, back away. I will not let you keep hurting my %3$s.
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.social_: %1$s, come closer. A hug is more interesting than running in circles.
Caught you, %2$s. Do not worry. I only wanted to feel your warmth.
Do not go stiff, %1$s. I only want a hug.
You are warmer than I expected, %2$s. All right, I will let go.
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.relatio: Now that is a familiar smell. You know how to choose.
For me? This is exactly right. I will remember you.
You even know what I like to eat, %1$s. Call me %3$s.
Perfect choice, %2$s. I am %3$s. Call for me next time you reach the water.
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.social_: Thank you, %1$s. You remembered what I like down here.
This needs to be fresh, %2$s. Your timing was perfect.
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.cat_ora: Move it away. That sour smell travels even farther through water.
No oranges. I can smell that one through the water, and it is awful.
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.friend_: Your friend is by the water. They trust you, so I will not pull you in.
With your friend beside you, this water is open to you for now.
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.pat_fri: Your friend spoke for you. All right, I accept.
Your hand is warm. No wonder they trust you.
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.pat_pla: Do not mind the splash. Your friend is here. I only want one touch.
They trust you, and I want a closer look too. Hold still.
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.compatr: Our %1$s is being attacked! Surround them. Do not let the human slip away!
The whole water heard it. Protect the %1$s and catch that human!
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.bond_wi: %1$s, let go! That is my %3$s. Do not hurt them in front of me.
%2$s, back away. If this continues, I will not know which side to stand on.
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.friend_: %2$s, I vouched for you in this water, and you hurt my %3$s? Stop!
%1$s, get away from my %3$s. Do not make me regret trusting you.
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.social_: %1$s, this time I am scooping you into my arms. Do not swim off yet.
Caught you, %2$s. Floating quietly still counts as play.
%1$s, come here. Let me hold you for a moment.
Got you, %2$s. Do not thrash. I will not drag you under.
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.relations: Hm, hm. That sure hit the spot. Thank you very much, partner! You really know my tastes.
Oh, so you knew I liked this a lot. You really know me very well.
You knew very well my type of food, %2$s. Alright, my name is %3$s, and as long as you carry such delicious foods, I'll be your partner.
Ah, winning me over with food, %1$s. You really know me well! %3$s, that's my name, don't forget it!
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.social_di: I never get tired of eating this, %1$s. You really know me well.
That's one good food choice, %2$s. Don't worry, I'll recognize both that food and your smell next time you're around.
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.cat_orang: UGH! That smell makes my nose all itchy!
AHH! Take that smell away! It... Makes me... Want to... Sneeze!
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.friend_re: I see a friend is tagging with you. As long as they trust you, I won't chase you.
I respect the friendship that connect you both. Say no more, come over and let me get your scent.
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.pat_frien: So your friend was right; your greeting is kind of weird, but very pleasing.
That's one friendly greeting alright! It seems your friend judged you well.
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.pat_playe: Hey! If your friend can pat you, then I want to pat you too!
The trust between you two is real. I would love to memorize that smell of yours, should we encounter paths again.
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.compatrio: Why you attacked my %1$s? This means war!
Our %1$s is under attack! ¡Everyone, fend off our enemies!
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.bond_witn: Hey, %2$s! That is my %3$s. Are you nuts?
Hey, %1$s! Stop, now! I won't tolerate you hurting my %3$s!
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.friend_wi: %2$s, I always steemed you, and yet you dare attack my %3$s? Back off, now!
%1$s, stop! If you hit again, I will be the one chasing you away.
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.social_pl: Aha! Caught you, %1$s! You thought I was going to transfur you? Nah, it's just a hug, silly.
Oho! So you're approaching me, %2$s! If you want a hug, then come as close as you want!
Got you, %1$s! Oh, don't worry, this is just a hug.
So, %2$s, you decided to take the road of the hugs, eh?
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.social_pl: As promised, %1$s. We let you go unharmed.
Alright, %2$s, we are now releasing you. Please do not trip over, ok?
Easy, %1$s. We will put you down safely. Don't struggle.
It was fun, %2$s. We would like another one of those later.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.social_pla: Alright, alright, %1$s. I'll take you down. Hey, don't grin at me!
Ok, down you go %2$s. If you want to play again, you know where to find me.
Ok, %1$s, I'll drop you. Be careful, don't trip on me!
Alright, that's enough, %2$s. I'll let you off now.
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.social_: Steady, %1$s. I am setting you down now.
All right, %2$s. I have loosened my hold.
Back on the ground, %1$s. Are you steady?
There, %2$s. You can move again.
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.social_: There you go, %1$s. I will let you drift free.
All right, %2$s. Swim on when you are ready.
Easy, %1$s. I am letting you go now.
There, %2$s. No splashing on the way out.
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.social_pl: Alright, %1$s. That was a nice hug. I won't mind going for another.
Okay, %2$s, I'm letting you go. That was fun!
Alright, %1$s. Time to continue with our shores.
That was really fun, %2$s! Let me know if you want to play again.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.friend_co: We sense hostiles around. %1$s, stay behind!
Stay close, %2$s. We can drive away the threats together.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.faction_c: %1$s, stay close to us. You will not face this alone here.
We all saw what it did. Step back, %1$s. We will deal with it.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.white_ter: We all felt that! Get closer. Let's stop the dangers together.
The pain... One of us is in danger! Drive the peril away!
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.white_hiv: Hsss! We all felt that. We will remember it!
The pain... We all felt it! Do not let it get away!
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.friend_ki: We trusted you, %1$s. We demand an explanation; why you killed our %3$s?
We all vouched for you. Still, we all refuse to accept you killing our %3$s. Stop now.
That is enough, %2$s. We cannot call you an ally anymore!
We warned you, and you ignored us. Stay away from our %3$s.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.friend_be: We haven't forgotten what you did. A pat is not enough to ask for forgiveness.
Take back your hand, %2$s. We are not ready to forgive you.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.friend_com: %1$s, stay behind me. I'll take it down!
Let's push together, %2$s. Don't let him any room for a counter.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.faction_co: %1$s, we're here to help you. Let us handle this.
The audacity! %1$s, come here, we'll take it down.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.friend_kin: That was my %3$s, %2$s. Lower the weapon. Now.
%1$s, I trusted you... Is my trust to you so not worth it?
Enough! You choose violence, so we're done in here. Stand back!
No more warnings, %2$s. Get away from my %3$s.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.friend_bet: Hands off! You cannot smooth this over with just a pat.
Stop now, %2$s. You won't get my trust back so easily.
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.friend_: %1$s, stay close. I can keep its attention off you.
I can smell its anger, %2$s. Let me meet it first.
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.faction: %1$s, step back. I will hold it here.
I remember your scent. Do not push yourself, %1$s.
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.white_t: We felt it too. Come closer while I pin it down.
Get back among us. I will bite down and keep it away.
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.white_h: Hss... I felt that, and now everyone knows where it is.
I remember that claw. The others do too.
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.friend_: My %3$s is dead. %1$s, back away before I turn on you.
I feel it... Your scent... Stinks... I don't like it.
I... I cannot trust you anymore. I refuse to hear you!
Too many of my %3$s are gone, %2$s. I will not let you take another.
You have broken the trust we once had. I cannot forget that easily.
Keep your hand back, %2$s. I do not trust your touch now.
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.friend_: %1$s, stay by me. I will cut it off.
It is coming straight for you, %2$s. Let me intercept it.
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.faction: %1$s, over here! I will cut it off.
It is coming for you. Stay near me, %1$s.
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.friend_: You killed my %3$s. %1$s, stop before this water turns against you.
I let you move safely among us. Do not make me regret it.
Enough, %2$s. You are no friend of mine after this.
Stay away from my %3$s. I will not warn you again.
No. Keep your hand out of my reach.
A gentle touch will not wash this away, %2$s.
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.friend_co: %1$s, there's an enemy over there! Back off, I'll take it out!
¡%2$s! Are you okay? I'm going to obliterate that thing!
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.faction_c: %1$s, come over here! Let's take it down together.
So that thing decided to take the path of violence. Fine, %1$s, let's go after it!
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.friend_ki: Hey, that was my %3$s! %1$s, have you gone mad?! Stop right this instant!
I thought we were friends. Don't make me choose between you and my %3$s.
No more! I won't take anymore of that from you! Stay away from me!
This is over, %2$s. You are no longer a friend. Come near my %3$s again and I will bring you down, mark my words!
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.friend_be: How you dare... I'm still mad at you!
Hands off, %2$s. You won't distract me this time with that.
menu.changed_synergy.social.follow_locke: Will travel with you once familiar
message.changed_synergy.social.follow_re: They are not ready to leave familiar ground with you. Spend more time together first.
